title: 地球与生命
zh: 地理社四卷：远行归来、星空菜园、动物救助站，210+347词。
paragraphs: Ms. Lin said the [[atmosphere:atmosphere]] is a thin cover that holds [[oxygen:oxygen]] for us to breathe.
She spun the globe and showed how the [[hydrosphere:hydrosphere]] covers most of the Earth with water.
Under the seas and land lies the rocky [[lithosphere:lithosphere]], drifting slowly on the hot [[mantle:mantle]].
She held up a rusty spike and said corrosion is an [[oxide:oxide]] formed when spikes meet wet air.
Plants take in [[carbon dioxide:carbon dioxide]] and grow tall in our warm school [[greenhouse:greenhouse]].
She added that water itself is made of [[hydrogen:hydrogen]] joined with oxygen.
Leo found the school's [[longitude:longitude]] and [[latitude:latitude]] on the old wall map.
At sundown they watched the sun go below the [[horizon:horizon]] from their campsite at high [[altitude:altitude]].
Last year a quake brought [[disaster:disaster]] and [[catastrophic:catastrophic]] harm to the riverside town.
The damaged wall still reminds everyone of that dreadful [[calamity:calamity]].
Leo once had only a small [[mishap:mishap]] when he dropped his compass on the stone stairs.
Climbing loose cliffs would [[endanger:endanger]] lives and [[jeopardise:jeopardise]] the whole school outing.
A [[destructive:destructive]] storm, worsened by [[el nino:El Nino]], broke trees along the hill road.
Ms. Lin called the rainbow after the rain a beautiful pure [[phenomenon:phenomenon]].
Bo picked up a shiny [[pebble:pebble]] and tested it with his little red [[magnet:magnet]].
Miners once dug deep here for [[ore:ore]] rich in useful [[mineral:minerals]].
The old bridge was built of white [[marble:marble]], standing on hard grey [[granite:granite]].
Bo found a clear piece of [[quartz:quartz]] that shone brightly in his torch light.
A sudden [[gust:gust]] stole his cap, and then a soft [[breeze:breeze]] cooled the tired team.
Ms. Lin warned that the summer [[monsoon:monsoon]] would flood the roads below.
After dark a strong [[gale:gale]] shook the tents like a small [[hurricane:hurricane]].
They had practised drills for a spinning [[tornado:tornado]] and a coastal [[typhoon:typhoon]].
The old [[volcano:volcano]] above the town could [[erupt:erupt]] without any warning.
Mei studied the hot [[magma:magma]] and wrote a [[thermodynamic:thermodynamic]] report about the flow of heat.
The team moved their tents to open ground and slept in turns.
Down in the city, thick [[smog:smog]] and black [[fume:fume]] from old trucks filled the streets.
Morning [[mist:mist]] softened the bay before the morning bus left.
After the [[seismic:seismic]] siren sounded, everyone hurried uphill, fearing a [[tsunami:tsunami]].
Later, farmers spoke of a long [[drought:drought]] that cracked the dry fields.
Autumn rain then caused [[flooding:flooding]] and sent a brown [[torrent:torrent]] under the plank bridge.
Next April they crossed sheer slopes where an [[avalanche:avalanche]] could sweep the rocky [[terrain:terrain]].
Leo sketched the silent white [[landscape:landscape]] on the edge of the northern [[continent:continent]].
Mei explored a dark [[cave:cave]] while Leo measured the slowly melting [[glacier:glacier]].
No one spoke loudly, and the team moved in a careful straight line.
They camped early and dried their socks by a small warm campfire.
Below the ice they waded through a warm [[swamp:swamp]] down to the green river [[delta:delta]].
Cows grazed on the wide [[plain:plain]] and sheep on the high windy [[plateau:plateau]].
Tired travellers rested at a calm hidden [[oasis:oasis]] with palms and cool water.
Ms. Lin showed how the [[equator:equator]] divides the Earth into two [[hemisphere:hemispheres]].
White bears roam on the frozen [[arctic:Arctic]] ice.
The icy [[antarctic:Antarctic]] lies even farther south.
Their dream is to reach the North [[pole:Pole]] one day.
A hungry [[polar:polar]] giant prowled nearby while the guide explained Earth's tilted [[axis:axis]].
The thin springtime air began to [[deteriorate:deteriorate]], and the wind would [[aggravate:aggravate]] their frostbite.
Old tents [[degrade:degrade]] fast in such cold, so the team [[upgrade:upgrade]] them with thick warm linings.
Sea winds [[erode:erode]] the cliffs day and [[night:night]].
Tired of the ice, everyone dreamed of sailing home across the warm [[mediterranean:Mediterranean]].
The [[atlantic:Atlantic]] was crossed while [[marine:marine]] birds followed the ship.
The skipper trusted satellite [[navigation:navigation]] even in thick fog, until they sheltered in a calm wide [[gulf:Gulf]].
They landed on a [[quiet:quiet]] golden [[beach:beach]] for fresh water.
Next they walked slowly along the rocky [[coast:coast]] and gathered dry driftwood.
Later they camped peacefully on the golden [[shore:shore]] beneath bright stars.
They packed up early and left before the rising [[tide:tide]] covered their footprints.
They jumped quickly over a slim [[brook:brook]] and followed a winding [[stream:stream]] through tall pines.
The water was clear and [[shallow:shallow]], yet the guide warned against [[superficial:superficial]] judgments about safety.
They rented a small dry [[flat:flat]] near the path's end.
Its stone floor felt surprisingly [[smooth:smooth]] beneath their tired shoeless feet.
The outer walls stayed [[rough:rough]] and dark with moss.
Behind the house a dry [[sandy:sandy]] path climbed toward the far hills.
At daybreak they left along a hard [[stony:stony]] path toward a tall [[vertical:vertical]] cliff.
They climbed the [[steep:steep]] mountainside slowly, staying between two [[parallel:parallel]] ridges.
Near the top they crossed a [[narrow:narrow]] [[wooden:wooden]] bridge over a deep gap.
There they met cheerful hikers from faraway [[oceania:Oceania]].
Together they planned a future [[trip:trip]] to a windy southern [[peninsula:peninsula]].
They checked the changing [[weather:weather]] once more before the long way down.
The path down led them straight to a little wooden shack.
At the little station they studied basic [[meteorology:meteorology]] on a surprisingly [[mild:mild]] afternoon.
The old electric [[heating:heating]] kept the room warm while they ate a [[moderate:moderate]] dinner.
Each of them wore a thick [[thermal:thermal]] coat against the night cold.
They compared this cold with the wet heat of the distant [[tropics:tropics]].
One researcher had once worked in an [[arid:arid]] [[desert:desert]] where nothing grows.
Outdoors, the evening soil stayed soft and [[moist:moist]] after light rain.
Late at night their coats still felt cold and [[damp:damp]] from the rain.
The small room turned uncomfortably [[humid:humid]] as wet clothing dried by the heater.
By morning they spotted white [[snowy:snowy]] peaks glowing in pale sunshine.
Thin [[frost:frost]] covered the windows and their stiff boots.
Suddenly loud [[hail:hail]] pounded on the roof and woke the whole station.
By noon the fallen ice began to [[thaw:thaw]] under the weak sun.
Far to the north, another legend was unfolding in the cold.
Yet the evening [[chill:chill]] soon forced them back inside before the puddles could [[freeze:freeze]].
Old Lars faced [[frigid:frigid]] winds on the frozen northern pier.
His hands began to [[tremble:tremble]] as icy spray soaked his gloves.
Soon he was [[shiver:shivering]] despite his thick fleece coat.
He tied the boat fast and hurried toward the warm [[harbour:harbour]] lights.
Then distant [[thunder:thunder]] rolled across the dark heavy clouds.
Suddenly bright [[lightning:lightning]] tore the sky above his small boat.
The [[stormy:stormy]] waves tossed the boat against the harbour wall.
A sudden [[downpour:downpour]] drenched him while he pulled the last rope.
He later learned that evening's [[rainfall:rainfall]] broke the village mark.
Back home, he marked the date in red on the wall calendar.
Early in the morning, Mina [[sprinkle:sprinkles]] sugar into her tea and takes a quick [[shower:shower]] before the ascent.
Outdoors it is already twenty-five degrees [[celsius:Celsius]], and such high [[temperature:temperature]] softens the deep snow.
Yet the radio [[forecast:forecast]] promises cool winds near the snowy [[peak:peak]].
By noon she stands on the high path, laughing at her own haste.
There she helps her friend [[mount:mount]] a small detector on the boulder.
Together they beheld the distant glowing [[mountain:mountain]] crest in the evening light.
Young Ken knows all the nearby [[range:ranges]] well and leads guests along the narrow [[ridge:ridge]].
They come down the grassy [[slope:slope]] into a peaceful green [[valley:valley]] dotted with sheep.
Children rush down the sunny [[hillside:hillside]] where Ken [[overlook:overlooks]] the whole village.
His grandmother hung an [[oriental:oriental]] tapestry and says guarding the land is an [[inevitable:inevitable]] task.
Ana studies [[irreversible:irreversible]] harm in the wetlands, sampling the water [[irregularly:irregularly]].
Dumping waste here would be highly [[inappropriate:inappropriate]], and last April she found [[abnormal:abnormal]] algae by the old conduit.
The slow river carries thick [[sediment:sediment]] while soft [[silt:silt]] settles among the roots.
After storms the bank turns soft and [[muddy:muddy]], so she moulds damp [[clay:clay]] into small demo bricks.
At daybreak Sam wipes [[dirt:dirt]] from his windscreen before his long [[rural:rural]] delivery run.
His [[first:first]] stop is a quiet farm, his second a leafy [[suburb:suburb]] full of waiting children.
Then come the factories on the dusty [[outskirts:outskirts]] of town.
After lunch he drives on toward a [[remote:remote]] shanty down a lonely [[desolate:desolate]] road.
Two warehouses stand [[adjacent:adjacent]] to the old station, but Sam refuses any [[toxic:toxic]] shipment without sealed boxes.
Maya investigates river [[pollution:pollution]] and finds one oily [[pollutant:pollutant]] leaking from a rusty conduit.
That waste could [[contaminate:contaminate]] the wells, so her class joins weekend [[geology:geology]] outings.
They take samples along the grassy [[fringe:fringe]] of the pines, where Maya drops her enamel [[plate:plate]] on the rocks.
The flood has scattered sharp [[debris:debris]] across the path, and she spots a thin [[crack:crack]] spreading in the old bridge wall.
She photographs both and sends them to the county hall the same day.
Leo photographed the [[splendid:splendid]] [[sunrise:sunrise]] above the quiet lake.
Later he visited a [[grand:grand]] palace built by ancient kings.
The vast canyon looked truly [[magnificent:magnificent]] as the guide told a very [[interesting:interesting]] legend.
Then a [[dramatic:dramatic]] wind turned the sky from blue to black over the silent [[wilderness:wilderness]].
At [[dawn:dawn]] they crossed a hot dry desert of low prickly bushes.
Seeing the fallen trees, Leo vowed never to [[deforest:deforest]] land for profit.
Our village once struggled beside a vast [[barren:barren]] plain without crops.
Then we found deep [[fertile:fertile]] soil along the riverbank.
Every [[spring:spring]] we [[fertilise:fertilise]] the fields before sowing the golden barley.
Tall [[solar:solar]] panels now drive the pumps that lift river water.
At night Grandpa studies the pale [[lunar:lunar]] light while planning the reaping.
We rise early to watch the golden sunrise spread over the barley.
After hard work we gather to enjoy the peaceful [[sunset:sunset]].
Last autumn we even watched a strange partial [[eclipse:eclipse]] together.
At [[dusk:dusk]] the village walks home under a glowing sky like soft [[heaven:heaven]].
Someone whispers that our valley feels exactly like a green [[paradise:paradise]].
Thin white [[vapour:vapour]] rises softly from the warm soup pots.
Daytime heat makes shallow pools quickly [[evaporate:evaporate]] in the bright sun.
Cool breezes happily [[circulate:circulate]] through the lanes after the hot afternoon.
A spat over water almost [[precipitate:precipitated]] a serious clash last summer.
Luckily the old stone [[reservoir:reservoir]] holds enough water for everyone.
Next morning the children trek together toward the noisy distant [[waterfall:waterfall]].
They laugh around the old stone [[fountain:fountain]] in the sunny square.
Fresh morning [[dew:dew]] still covers the soft turf along the path.
Grandpa kindly [[pour:pours]] hot tea for every tired and parched child.
Rainwater will slowly [[drain:drain]] through narrow channels into the lower fields.
A loose faucet keeps [[drip:dripping]] all night beside the old granary.
Heavy floods could easily [[drown:drown]] heedless walkers on the low roads without proper warnings.
Suddenly a strong mountain wind begins to [[blow:blow]] leaves across the yard.
Little Tao starts to [[puff:puff]] as he climbs the steep stone steps.
Cool spring water [[gush:gushes]] suddenly from cracks in the mossy rocks.
They enter into a quiet old forest, dark and [[dense:dense]], full of tall pines.
The scorching [[intensity:intensity]] of the noon sun soon forces a rest.
Their teacher leads an [[intensive:intensive]] walk to learn the native plants.
A shy deer [[emerge:emerges]] suddenly from behind the thick green bushes.
The children see a bright [[flash:flash]] where [[sunlight:sunlight]] crosses the clear stream.
Dry leaves gently [[float:float]] downstream toward the calm wide river.
Grandpa says the forest's [[condition:condition]] has greatly improved this year.
Yet the water [[situation:situation]] still worries every family.
He tells the children that loving [[nature:nature]] means guarding each living thing.
They prefer the clear [[natural:natural]] lake to the tiled pool.
The new square uses pretty [[artificial:artificial]] flowers to save precious water.
Most tents there use rugged [[synthetic:synthetic]] cloth that stands up to heavy rain.
Uncle Wang still buys costly [[petrol:petrol]] for his old jeep every Friday.
Burning that dirty [[gas:gas]] fills the air with choking smoke.
He hopes cheaper clean [[gasoline:gasoline]] will soon take its place.
But experts say [[local:local]] [[petroleum:petroleum]] reserves cannot support the village for long.
So the village assembly votes to keep the woods and save water first.
Leo studied the [[cosmos:cosmos]] and the vast [[galaxy:galaxy]] above.
The [[interstellar:interstellar]] space and the [[universe:universe]] fascinated him deeply.
He distinguished the [[celestial:celestial]] bodies from the [[terrestrial:terrestrial]] ones.
The difference between [[astrology:astrology]] and [[astronomy:astronomy]] became clear to him.
Sam wore a cardboard [[astronaut:astronaut]] hat and pointed at a bright [[comet:comet]] in the east.
Grandpa mailed a tiny [[meteorite:meteorite]] piece and a photo of a circular [[crater:crater]] yesterday.
They wiped grey [[dust:dust]] from the old ledge and found [[ash:ash]] from burnt cardboard strips.
A loose [[chunk:chunk]] of painted wood fell off their model [[spacecraft:spacecraft]] during cleaning.
They fixed the toy [[spaceship:spaceship]] and tied a small [[probe:probe]] next to its door.
Leo added a new [[module:module]] at the back to show simple [[propulsion:propulsion]] with air.
Sam pressed the balloon gently to demo air [[pressure:pressure]] and basic soaring [[dynamics:dynamics]].
The balloon's fast [[motion:motion]] pushed air through the small red [[vent:vent]] loudly.
The bright [[tail:tail]] drew a soft [[curve:curve]] across the darkening blue sky.
Their veranda [[exploration:exploration]] felt like a real [[expedition:expedition]] to distant cold worlds.
They acted out a bold [[flyby:flyby]] and pretended the railing was an [[observatory:observatory]] dome.
Through the small [[telescope:telescope]], the moon became a silver [[spectacle:spectacle]] for everyone.
Leo traced the moon's [[orbit:orbit]] and showed where the dim [[ecliptic:ecliptic]] line runs.
He compared the mirror's [[diameter:diameter]] with its [[radius:radius]] using a school ruler.
Morning came, and they tested the potting [[substance:substance]] to learn its basic [[composition:composition]].
The shop mix had one strange [[compound:compound]] and a toy [[fossil:fossil]] buried inside.
Mia took a small [[sample:sample]] of soil and labelled her best leaf [[specimen:specimen]] carefully.
Each tiny [[particle:particle]] holds water, and every [[molecule:molecule]] helps young shoots grow.
Leo said each [[atom:atom]] trades an [[ion:ion]] in the salty water mix.
Sam read that one [[electron:electron]] displacement is a tiny [[quantum:quantum]] transition in leaves.
They poured clear [[liquid:liquid]] slowly and watched the [[fluid:fluid]] spread through the trays.
The dry [[solid:solid]] base cannot [[synthesise:synthesise]] food without proper care and warmth.
They logged each cloud [[formation:formation]] and checked the light [[spectrum:spectrum]] at noon.
Leo measured each box [[dimension:dimension]] and noted the watering [[frequency:frequency]] on cards.
A bent wire acted as their wind [[signal:signal]], shaking like a thin [[antenna:antenna]].
They fixed a lamp [[circuit:circuit]] and watched [[refraction:refraction]] curve lines in the beaker.
They blocked harsh [[ultraviolet:ultraviolet]] rays and avoided an old [[radioactive:radioactive]] meter completely.
Two pots showed [[distinct:distinct]] marks with one [[discernible:discernible]] streak on each tag.
An [[invisible:invisible]] snail caused a funny [[collision:collision]] between two empty cans.
They moved a soft [[squash:squash]] aside and threw each damaged [[fragment:fragment]] away.
No [[cataclysmic:cataclysmic]] storm arrived, only [[overwhelming:overwhelming]] heat at noon yesterday.
Mia felt brief [[despair:despair]], then took [[desperate:desperate]] steps to cool the trays.
Nothing felt [[hopeless:hopeless]] once they learned how [[photosynthesis:photosynthesis]] feeds green shoots.
Leaves [[respire:respire]] at night, trading fresh air for dim [[dioxide:dioxide]] traces.
New [[vegetation:vegetation]] covered the railing, with one tiny [[herb:herb]] beside the chair.
A calm [[perennial:perennial]] survived winter and sparked their love for [[botany:botany]] books.
Their veranda [[ecology:ecology]] grew into a small [[ecosystem:ecosystem]] with bees and worms.
They chose [[eco-friendly:eco-friendly]] pots and read a simple [[horticulture:horticulture]] guide together.
Each tiny [[organism:organism]] follows [[genetics:genetics]] rules that shape colour and size.
One strange [[mutation:mutation]] gave pleasant [[variation:variation]] in petal spots this spring.
They loved the growing [[diversity:diversity]] and tried careful [[hybridisation:hybridisation]] between cousins.
Good plants [[reproduce:reproduce]] quickly and slowly [[evolve:evolve]] to suit the veranda air.
Spring temperatures [[fluctuate:fluctuate]], so they [[reclaim:reclaim]] old boxes for cover.
They [[cultivate:cultivate]] calm habits and [[sow:sow]] new rows every second weekend.
At last they [[harvest:harvest]] together and [[pluck:pluck]] only what the cooks need.
Each box gave a fair [[yield:yield]], and they [[rear:rear]] worms in one corner.
No [[arable:arable]] land exists here, so they [[plough:plough]] the tubs with forks.
Leo holds the small [[spade:spade]] while Sam pulls the light [[rake:rake]] steadily.
They [[stack:stack]] washed pots neatly and aerate a rich compost [[heap:heap]] daily.
Mia ties a neat [[bundle:bundle]] of sticks and a fresh [[bunch:bunch]] for neighbours.
The best cuts fill a blue [[vase:vase]] that catches morning sunlight softly.
[[short day:Short day]] greens and [[shade-tolerant:shade-tolerant]] ferns share the cool north corner.
They scrubbed one [[fungus:fungus]] spot and wiped grey [[mould:mould]] from the dish edge.
Yellow [[pollen:pollen]] covered the table where new beans [[germinate:germinate]] in moss.
Each saved [[seed:seed]] seems to [[burgeon:burgeon]] after three warm spring mornings.
Every firm [[bud:bud]] may open into a pink [[blossom:blossom]] by Friday.
Each fresh [[bloom:bloom]] adds a sweet [[scent:scent]] to their evening talks.
The small [[aromatic:aromatic]] leaves [[ripen:ripen]] slowly beside the warm glass wall.
They pick each red [[fruit:fruit]] before hot winds make petals [[wither:wither]].
Fallen bits [[decompose:decompose]] fast, or wet stems [[rot:rot]] in the corner.
They clear slow [[decay:decay]] and hand [[stale:stale]] crumbs to the birds.
Their display mimics a wet [[rainforest:rainforest]] corner like a tiny [[jungle:jungle]] exhibit.
Photos of a tea [[plantation:plantation]] and a windy barley [[field:field]] move them.
Old [[timber:timber]] crates and a small [[charcoal:charcoal]] doodle brightens their work wall.
A [[forestry:forestry]] poster shows how to prune one crowded [[branch:branch]] safely.
They painted a thick [[trunk:trunk]] with one stout [[bough:bough]] for climbing cats.
A shallow [[root:root]] mass rests under a thin [[hay:hay]] cover till morning.
They spread dry [[straw:straw]] around shoots and tie one tall [[reed:reed]] upright.
Leo pulls each sharp [[thorn:thorn]] stalk and every spreading [[weed:weed]] early.
Fresh [[grass:grass]] clippings bring back a wide [[meadow:meadow]] walk from last June.
They clip the tiny [[lawn:lawn]] edge near a young [[olive:olive]] sapling.
A bonsai [[pine:pine]] stands cool beside a curling [[vine:vine]] trellis.
One [[violet:violet]] tag marks the Dutch [[tulip:tulip]] row by date.
Crushed [[mint:mint]] smells fresh while the coral [[reef:reef]] book lies open.
Green [[alga:alga]] coats the beaker where a busy [[enzyme:enzyme]] breaks waste down.
Warmth acts as a [[catalyst:catalyst]] and helps shoots [[release:release]] firm covers.
They log scooter [[emission:emission]] outdoors and let broad leaves [[absorb:absorb]] moisture.
Good air [[circulation:circulation]] matters, and pots must never [[exceed:exceed]] two sprouts.
Slow [[uptake:uptake]] of each [[nutrient:nutrient]] keeps the young stems firm.
Clean [[surroundings:surroundings]] support each natural defence [[mechanism:mechanism]] beneath the soil every week.
New shade nets [[counterbalance:counterbalance]] harsh light and [[protect:protect]] young shoots at noon.
Fallen petals are [[preserve:preserve]]d for art and [[conservation:conservation]] rules learned together.
How crews stop a [[bush fire:bush fire]] and [[extinguish:extinguish]] stray sparks is learned.
Litter [[destruction:destruction]] that could [[ruin:ruin]] nests along the river is disliked.
Weak shoots [[perish:perish]] fast if builders [[demolish:demolish]] the old side wall.
They never [[infringe:infringe]] park rules or [[undermine:undermine]] shared beds with chemicals.
They read about bee [[extinction:extinction]] and map each visiting [[pattern:pattern]] carefully.
Every small [[outcome:outcome]] counts, and kind acts create a real [[impact:impact]].
Their wall chart mixes [[seasonal:seasonal]] tasks with one small [[experimental:experimental]] corner.
Warm spring gives [[favourable:favourable]] light for long [[productive:productive]] afternoons together.
A simple rota proves [[effective:effective]] and keeps their watering [[efficient:efficient]] daily.
They feel [[considerable:considerable]] pride, though the plot is not [[massive:massive]] yet.
The night sky gives [[immense:immense]] calm with [[maximal:maximal]] stars above town.
With [[minimal:minimal]] noise and [[optimal:optimal]] darkness, Leo ends the happy evening.
On Saturday morning Leo joined a kind [[zoologist:zoologist]] and a friendly [[ecologist:ecologist]] at the gate.
A cheerful [[botanist:botanist]] showed them a soft baby [[mammal:mammal]] sleeping in warm straw.
They watched a playful [[primate:primate]] swing while learning about each strong [[vertebrate:vertebrate]] in care.
Next they cleaned a slow [[reptile:reptile]] enclosure and a small green [[amphibian:amphibian]] pool nearby.
Leo learned that a meat eating [[carnivore:carnivore]] needs different meals than a grass eating [[herbivore:herbivore]].
Every little [[creature:creature]] at the station deserves quiet care and fresh [[wildlife:wildlife]] support daily.
They mapped local [[fauna:fauna]] with pictures and noted the tall [[flora:flora]] around the lake.
Each rescued [[species:species]] was listed, and a happy [[flock:flock]] of ducks passed overhead.
Leo spotted a calm [[herd:herd]] of deer drink while a busy [[swarm:swarm]] of bees moved past.
A noisy [[throng:throng]] of visitors arrived, but a bigger weekend [[crowd:crowd]] came after lunch.
A large tired [[beast:beast]] rested quietly, and even a rough [[brute:brute]] dog looked calm today.
No [[cruel:cruel]] hands are allowed here, because kindness must [[originate:originate]] from every young heart.
They [[derive:derive]] pleasure from small tasks that [[stem:stem]] from love for living things.
An old photo showed an [[ancestor:ancestor]] of the gibbon with its happy [[descendant:descendant]] beside it.
The mother nursed her tiny [[offspring:offspring]] while a separate [[subgroup:subgroup]] played in the grass.
Volunteers [[feed:fed]] the young birds and learned how experts [[breed:breed]] rare ducks safely.
They never [[interbreed:interbreed]] close families and never [[hybridise:hybridise]] free ducks with farm ones.
Rabbits could [[proliferate:proliferate]] fast, so vets check health to avoid painful [[sterility:sterility]] issues.
Spring [[courtship:courtship]] songs filled the air before tiny chicks began to [[hatch:hatch]] in boxes.
A quiet duck began to [[brood:brood]] softly while trout started to [[spawn:spawn]] in the pool.
A young bird looked almost [[mature:mature]] but still had a sharp little [[claw:claw]] cut.
Leo cleaned a soft [[paw:paw]] with warm water and gently fixed a cracked [[beak:beak]] cover.
They checked a torn [[fin:fin]] on a trout and a weak little [[wing:wing]] on a duck.
A loose grey [[plume:plume]] fell softly, and Leo saved each tiny brown [[feather:feather]] for study.
A piglet raised its stiff [[bristle:bristle]] hairs, then slept in a snug warm [[curl:curl]].
They counted each buzzing [[insect:insect]] near the flowers and moved a pink [[worm:worm]] off the path.
They removed a destructive garden [[pest:pest]] by hand and washed off a tiny leaf [[parasite:parasite]] too.
A small striped [[spider:spider]] hung in the corner while a loud green [[cricket:crickets]] sang outdoors.
They helped an old tired [[seal:seal]] rest and lifted a heavy sleepy [[tortoise:tortoises]] into shade.
A baby sea [[turtle:turtle]] swam in circles while a distant huge [[whale:whales]] sang low songs.
A jumping [[kangaroo:kangaroo]] ate fresh leaves while traders once stole white [[ivory:ivory]] for money.
They polished a curved antelope [[horn:horn]] model and heard a far lonely [[wolf:wolves]] howl at night.
A Komodo [[dragon:dragon]] slept behind glass while a quick red [[fox:foxes]] sniffed the morning air.
Leo broke a square food [[cube:cubes]] into bits and gave one to a parched spotted [[calf:calf]].
A wet newborn [[pup:pup]] shivered in towels while a soft white [[lamb:lamb]] drank warm milk.
The quiet milk [[cattle:cattle]] stood in line while a strong brown [[ox:oxen]] pulled a dray.
A loud angry [[bull:bull]] stamped its feet while a calm grey [[buffalo:buffalo]] chewed long grass.
Leo brushed a tall brown [[horse:horse]] gently and waved at a striped calm [[zebra:zebra]] nearby.
A kind grey [[donkey:donkey]] carried light bags while Leo cleaned a worn skin [[saddle:saddle]] nearby.
A fast grey [[falcon:falcon]] circled high above while a sharp eyed [[hawk:hawk]] waited in a tree.
A stately bald [[eagle:eagle]] sat very still while a sleepy brown [[owl:owl]] blinked in the dark.
A tiny hungry [[sparrow:sparrow]] pecked at seeds while a grey mild [[pigeon:pigeon]] drank clean water.
A black noisy [[crow:crow]] hopped near the railing while a white calm [[swan:swan]] floated on water.
A white farm [[goose:goose]] honked for feed while a red stately [[cock:cock]] strutted in the yard.
A tiny brown [[mouse:mouse]] hid under straw while a quick grey [[rat:rats]] ran behind the door.
A red quick [[squirrel:squirrel]] climbed the oak while a shy brown [[hare:hare]] sat in clover.
A green little [[frog:frog]] jumped near the gutter, showing calm watchful [[behaviour:behaviour]] each hour.
Leo learned that a deep [[bite:bites]] could ache and a bee [[sting:sting]] could puff fast.
Dogs gave a short warning [[bark:bark]] at first, then a lion gave a low sleepy [[roar:roar]].

芳香的小叶在温暖的玻璃墙边慢慢成熟。
他们在热风吹蔫花瓣前摘下每颗红果。
落下的碎屑很快分解，不然湿茎就会在角落腐烂。
他们清理缓慢腐朽的东西，把不新鲜的碎屑递给小鸟。
他们的展示架模仿潮湿的雨林角落，像个小丛林展区。
茶园和风中大麦田的照片打动了他们。
旧木箱和一张小炭笔涂鸦点亮他们的工作墙。
一张林业海报展示如何安全修剪拥挤的枝条。
他们画了粗树干和一根粗壮的大枝，给爬树的猫玩。
浅浅的根团在薄干草盖下直到天亮。
他们在嫩苗周围铺干稻草，把一株高芦苇绑直。
利奥趁早拔掉每根尖刺茎和蔓延的杂草。
新鲜的草屑勾起去年六月宽阔草甸散步的回忆。
他们修剪小草坪的边缘，旁边是一株年轻的橄榄苗。
一株盆景松静静立在蜿蜒的藤架旁。
一张紫罗兰色标签按日期标出荷兰郁金香那一畦。
压碎的薄荷清香扑鼻，珊瑚礁书摊开在一旁。
绿藻包住烧杯，忙碌的酶在里面分解废物。
温暖充当催化剂，帮嫩芽松开紧裹的外衣。
他们记录户外的机车排放，让宽叶吸收湿气。
空气流通很重要，每盆绝不能超过两株苗。
每种养分缓慢吸收，嫩茎就长得稳。
干净的周围环境每周都支撑着土壤下的天然防御机制。
新遮阳网抵消强光，正午保护着幼小的苗。
落花被保留用于艺术创作，自然保护规则也一同学习。
学习如何让机组扑灭灌木火灾并扑灭散落的火星。
可能毁坏河边鸟巢的垃圾破坏行为令人反感。
如果工人拆掉旧侧墙，弱苗很快就会死掉。
他们从不违反公园规定，也不用化学品伤害共享菜地。
他们读蜜蜂灭绝的故事，仔细画下每次到访的规律。
每个小成果都算数，善意的行为会带来真正的影响。
他们的墙表把季节性任务和一小块试验角排在一起。
温暖的春天给他们有利的光，度过漫长而多产的午后。
简单的轮值表很有效，让每天浇水都很高效。
他们感到相当自豪，虽然小菜地还不算大。
夜空带来巨大的宁静，小镇上空星星达到最多。
噪音最小、黑暗正好，利奥结束了快乐的夜晚。
周六早晨里奥在大门口加入一位和善的动物学家和一位友好的生态学家。
一位开朗的植物学家给他们看了一只睡在暖草里的柔软哺乳动物宝宝。
他们看一只爱玩的灵长类荡秋千并学习每只强壮的脊椎动物的照护。
接着他们清洗行动缓慢的爬行动物饲养箱和旁边小绿两栖动物水池。
里奥学到食肉动物和食草动物需要的食物很不一样。
救助站的每个小生物都值得安静照护和每天新鲜的野生生物支持。
他们用图片记录当地动物群并记下湖边高大的植物群。
每个获救物种都被登记一只快乐的鸭群从头顶飞过。
里奥望见平静的鹿群喝水一只忙碌的蜜蜂群经过。
一群吵闹的参观者到了午饭后更大的周末人群又来了。
一只疲惫的大兽安静休息连一只粗鲁的猛犬今天也很安静。
这里不允许残酷的手因为善良必须源自每颗年轻的心。
他们从源于热爱生命的小任务中获得愉悦。
老照片里长臂猿的祖先和它快乐的后代站在一起。
妈妈照顾小小的后代另一个小群在草地上玩。
志愿者给幼鸟喂食并学习专家如何安全繁殖稀有鸭子。
他们从不让近亲异种交配也从不让散养鸭和农场鸭杂交。
兔子可能会快速繁殖所以兽医检查健康避免痛苦的不育问题。
求偶的歌声充满春天小鸡开始在箱子里孵出。
一只安静的鸭子开始静卧，鳟鱼开始在水池产卵。
一只幼鸟快成熟了但小利爪还有伤口。
里奥用温水清洗柔软的爪子并固定开裂的鸟喙护罩。
他们检查鳟鱼身上撕裂的鳍和鸭子身上无力的小翅膀。
一根松软的灰色大羽毛落下，里奥收好每根棕色小羽毛做研究。
小猪竖起硬刚毛然后蜷成暖暖一团睡觉。
他们数花边的嗡嗡昆虫并把粉色蠕虫移到路边。
他们用手捉走毁坏性的园林害虫并洗掉小叶上的寄生虫。
角落里小条纹蜘蛛垂着，户外绿色大蟋蟀在叫。
他们扶疲惫的老海豹休息把沉重的瞌睡陆龟抬到阴凉处。
海龟宝宝绕圈游泳远处巨大的鲸低声歌唱。
跳跃的袋鼠吃鲜叶而商人曾为钱偷白色象牙。
他们擦拭弯曲的羚羊角模型听到远处孤独的狼群夜里嚎叫。
科莫多龙在玻璃后睡觉红色敏捷的狐狸嗅着晨空。
里奥把方形食物块掰碎分给干渴的斑点牛犊。
湿漉漉的新生幼犬在毛巾里发抖柔软的小白羊羔喝温奶。
安静的奶牛排队站立强壮的棕色公牛拉着板车。
大声愤怒的公牛跺脚平静的灰水牛嚼长草。
里奥轻刷高大棕马并向附近条纹温顺斑马挥手。
和善的灰驴驮着轻包里奥在旁边擦旧皮马鞍。
灰色敏捷的隼在高空盘旋目光锐利的鹰在树上等待。
威严的白头鹰安静坐着瞌睡的棕色猫头鹰在黑暗中眨眼。
饥饿的小麻雀啄种子灰色温顺的鸽子喝清水。
黑色吵闹的乌鸦在扶栏边跳白色安静的天鹅浮在水面。
白色农场鹅为饲料叫红色威严的公鸡在院里走。
棕色小老鼠藏在草下，灰色敏捷的大鼠跑到门后。
红色敏捷的松鼠爬橡树害羞的棕色野兔坐在三叶草里。
绿色小青蛙跳到排水沟边每小时都表现平静警觉的行为。
里奥学到深咬会痛蜜蜂蜇会快速肿起。
狗先发出短促警告吠叫接着狮子发出低沉困倦的吼叫。
里奥不在灰尘里揉眼睛也不靠近围栏潜行。
孩子们学会低姿爬过绳索并尊重周围每个自然栖息地。
他们清理灌木里空小巢并远远看嗡嗡的木蜂箱。
里奥透过小玻璃细胞培养皿看并擦生锈的空笼门。
他们打扫温暖干燥的马厩地板并在红色谷仓阁楼堆干草。
他们修剪路边低绿树篱并粉刷白色木栅栏门。
兽医讲解基础鸟类解剖图并提醒过去家禽流行病那一年。
他们学到一个微小基因变化会在体内携带弱小隐藏病菌。
实验室发现样本里有无害口腔细菌冬天没有危险病毒。
每个看不见的微生物都被记录缓慢的冬天代谢让很多蛇安静。
他们在餐里加高蛋白豆子并给鹦鹉加橙色维生素滴剂。
病腺体会分泌浓液健康肾脏每天排泄废物。
饥饿的雏鸟会凭敏锐的夜晚本能快速吞食食物。
里奥凭直觉猜到口渴并感受到休息真正的治愈潜力。
团队夸他智力增长并用圆木搭了结实实用的栖木。
护士对轻声保持敏感对胆小鸟儿保持平静灵活的接触。
蝙蝠用柔和声学回声移动鸭子黄昏需要敏锐视觉聚焦。
许多蝙蝠夜里忙碌夜行蟾蜍白天瞌睡休眠。
冬天蛰伏慢慢结束帮工细心追踪体重表。
他们在水里没发现疾病痕迹走备用小路回基地。
弱兔在安静饥饿捕食者等待时会变成容易捕捉的猎物。
这里没有小动物成为无助受害者也没有孤独圈养动物久难过。
员工在围栏边保持警戒平静每个新人必须接受安全入门培训。
旧伤在冷雨里还会作痛虚弱老鸟今天觉得脆弱。
他们种豆子维持每天生计从不灭杀当地蛇。
里奥学会耐心驯服惊恐和善的首席饲养员夸他做得好。
日落时温和的老牧羊人带狗来看望感谢每位疲惫帮工。
paraZh: 林老师用鸡蛋讲地球圈层：大气、水圈、岩石圈与地幔。
查经纬、看日落，回忆地震大灾，立下安全规矩。
厄尔尼诺与受伤森林、温室、彩虹，小波捡石测磁。
采石场识矿石，阵风微风过后，季风将至。
风暴火山轮番预警，小梅记下岩浆热数据。
烟雾城镇、海啸警报、干旱洪水，小队装上地震仪。
翻雪山、穿地形，进山洞测冰川。
下到沼泽三角洲，再从平原高原一路想到南北极。
极地熊与倾斜地轴，天气恶化，升级帐篷。
横渡大西洋进海湾，金滩海岸露营，趁涨潮前撤离。
沿溪流进山谷，浅水处不受表象迷惑，石屋落脚。
日出登峭壁，过窄桥遇大洋洲旅人，相约半岛再看天气。
气象站温和午后，暖气配适量晚餐，谈热带与干旱。
午夜潮湿，清晨雪霜，冰雹转融化。
傍晚寒夜，码头严寒渔夫颤抖，雷声滚来。
雷电风暴夜暴雨破纪录，红圈记日子。
米娜清晨备登山，高温、预报指引登顶。
肯带客走山脊进山谷；湿地取样识污染。
沉积淤泥制砖；送货路线一路向远。
仓库拒运有毒品；小玛雅查河污，桥缝拍照上报。
峡谷日出宫殿传说，荒野沙漠立誓护林。
荒原边发现肥沃河岸，施肥装太阳能，看日出。
赏日落观日食，黄昏天堂山谷，水汽蒸发。
争水水库平息；瀑布喷泉露珠，李爷爷倒茶。
倒茶排水滴水防洪，登山喘气。
泉涌密林休整，集训遇鹿见溪光。
落叶漂流，森林好转水仍忧，用新人造物。
拖拉机油烟盼替代，石油难久恃，投票护林节水。
三个社团伙伴夜晚聚在阳台，从星系聊到陨石，开启观星之夜。
他们擦拭修补飞船模型，用气球演示飞行原理。
他们用望远镜赏月观星，辨认轨道并记录尺寸。
清晨他们化身小科学家，研究盆土、取样观察微粒。
他们摆弄水灯铁丝，观察流动、光影与信号。
小意外不断：蜗牛相撞、南瓜挪位、酷热来袭，他们冷静应对。
他们学到光合作用，阳台变成生机勃勃的小生态。
他们观察遗传变异，坚持播种培育新苗。
他们一起收获、分工劳作，把成果分享给邻居。
花草发芽开花，蓝花瓶插满晨光中的剪枝。
花香果熟，他们清理落叶烂叶，布置雨林一角。
茶园照片带来灵感，他们布置木箱、护根绑苗。
他们除刺拔草、修剪草坪，花香薄荷香满阳台。
他们观察水罐生态，保持通风、养分均衡与环境整洁。
落花作艺术、学习防火、反感乱扔垃圾，自然保护意识在行动中生根。
他们记录蜜蜂、总结收获，轮值浇水让阳台高产。
夜幕下繁星满天，他们结束快乐充实的一天。
周六早晨里奥一行人来到救助站门口认识专家并了解动物。
大家记录动植物并看到鹿群蜜蜂群和两批游客与大动物。
从爱心获得快乐并学习繁殖知识与防止兔子过度繁殖。
春天雏鸟孵化以及检查爪子爪子脚爪鸟喙鱼鳍翅膀和羽毛。
清理小虫子并照顾蜘蛛蟋蟀海豹陆龟海龟和鲸。
看袋鼠象牙羚羊角狼科莫多龙狐狸并喂食方块饲料给牛犊幼犬羊羔牛和黄牛。
看公牛水牛马斑马驴马鞍隼鹰猫头鹰麻雀和鸽子。
看乌鸦天鹅鹅公鸡老鼠松鼠野兔青蛙并学习咬伤和蜇伤。
听犬吠狮吼并学习匍匐爬行清理鸟巢蜂箱细胞载玻片笼舍马厩和谷仓。
修剪树篱栅栏并学习解剖学传染病基因病菌细菌病毒微生物代谢蛋白和维生素。
学习分泌排泄吞食本能直觉潜能智力和功能栖木以及敏感灵活处理和回声定位。
学习夜行性休眠冬眠追踪踪迹备用路线猎物捕食者受害者圈养动物和防御培训。
雨天脆弱动物自给自足不灭杀并驯服恐惧感谢管理员和牧羊人。
subheads: 第一卷·远行——从课堂到山海极地
第二卷·归来——风暴过后是家园
第三卷·星空菜园——白天种菜夜晚观星
第四卷·动物救助站——周末义工

title: 校园与文化
zh: 新生学期与文化娱乐周，两卷读完。
paragraphs: Xiao Yu began his university life with strong hopes for future [[education:education]] and [[primary:primary]] goals.
He chose a noted [[secondary:secondary]] school near the new language [[institute:institute]] in town.
At the arts [[academy:academy]] he hoped to [[acquire:acquire]] many useful skills for life.
Teachers with great [[expertise:expertise]] welcomed every nervous [[novice:novice]] on Monday morning.
Clubs tried to [[recruit:recruit]] new members who were confident and fully [[literate:literate]] in English.
A talk about ending [[illiteracy:illiteracy]] showed how workers learn to [[numerate:numerate]] costs daily.
The welcome party was a happy [[affair:affair]] without any [[controversial:controversial]] speeches or debates.
An older game gave him a difficult [[puzzle:puzzle]] and a funny word [[riddle:riddle]] to unravel.
One rule seemed [[obscure:obscure]] at first, but teachers helped [[instil:instil]] good habits slowly.
He did not want to [[cram:cram]] at night, as advisors always [[emphasise:emphasise]] constant daily work.
Morning runs would [[enhance:enhance]] his health and [[enable:enable]] him to stay alert in class.
A kind roommate would [[inspire:inspire]] him, and friendship became his main [[motive:motive]] for effort.
Their long talks would [[motivate:motivate]] Xiao Yu and [[stimulate:stimulate]] his curiosity in reading.
A small win in English gave a useful [[spur:spur]] and new [[impetus:impetus]] for harder tasks.
He would not [[indulge:indulge]] in late games that could [[spoil:spoil]] his sleep and mood.
His roommate was very [[intelligent:intelligent]] and found [[clever:clever]] ways to remember new words.
She looked [[smart:smart]] in blue jeans and showed [[all round:all round]] talent in music and sports.
No one called him a [[genius:genius]], yet he trained with the [[elite:elite]] runners each dawn.
He never felt like an [[idiot:idiot]] because older friends shared useful [[wisdom:wisdom]] daily.
With quick [[wit:wit]] and natural [[aptitude:aptitude]] for sounds, he enjoyed speaking practice loudly.
Soon he felt [[capable:capable]] of doing [[outstanding:outstanding]] work in group discussions together.
A [[brilliant:brilliant]] talk by a visitor added [[prestige:prestige]] to the English evening gala.
The club built a good [[reputation:reputation]] after inviting an [[eminent:eminent]] visitor from Beijing.
Even a [[notorious:notorious]] late sleeper earned high [[esteem:esteem]] after helping everyone move rooms.
Xiao Yu stayed [[diligent:diligent]] and took [[painstaking:painstaking]] notes during every grammar lesson.
His simple [[approach:approach]] followed a clear weekly study [[scheme:scheme]] made with friends.
The kind [[headmaster:headmaster]] welcomed parents, and the associate [[principal:principal]] shook every hand.
The busy [[dean:dean]] introduced new teachers from every teaching [[faculty:faculty]] on podium.
One old [[professor:professor]] and a young visiting [[scholar:scholar]] answered questions with patience.
A friendly [[scientist:scientist]] and his kind English [[tutor:tutor]] joined the outing by the lake.
A funny [[lecturer:lecturer]] and her cheerful [[assistant:assistant]] showed short videos about city life.
As a class [[candidate:candidate]] he trained hard to [[qualify:qualify]] for the speech tourney finals.
Officials would [[certify:certify]] his hours and later hand a course [[diploma:diploma]] with seals.
A retired [[diplomat:diplomat]] and a cultural [[ambassador:ambassador]] spoke about travel and kind manners.
A visiting school [[pupil:pupil]] asked a new [[graduate:graduate]] how to pick good books for teens.
At the inaugural [[ceremony:ceremony]] a young [[bachelor:bachelor]] sang a warm song about home.
He hoped to [[master:master]] daily English as a confident college [[fresher:fresher]] in autumn.
A helpful [[sophomore:sophomore]] and a shy [[junior:junior]] showed him the rink and shops nearby.
A calm [[senior:senior]] told reports of successful [[alumni:alumni]] who now work in other cities.
During [[campus:campus]] walks the short [[orientation:orientation]] week helped him feel calm and safe.
On the hall steps, a new online learning [[platform:platform]] was shown to each [[coed:coed]] group.
He helped teachers [[register:register]] names and check the printed class [[roster:roster]] each morning.
He chose to [[enrol:enrol]] in two clubs before finishing his final [[matriculation:matriculation]] forms.
His new [[accommodation:accommodation]] was a small shared [[dorm:dorm]] with bright windows and fans.
At noon the crowded [[dining hall:dining hall]] felt warmer than the small street [[canteen:canteen]] nearby.
In the white [[laboratory:laboratory]] he watched a simple safe [[experiment:experiment]] with great care.
He copied key [[data:data]] about food prices and checked each [[quantity:quantity]] twice for homework.
He chose seats for their quiet [[quality:quality]] inside the tall old [[library:library]] near water.

白云好像滑行，孩子们在软垫上翻滚。
小孩慢慢学滑雪，再跟朋友滑冰。
绿车带来骑行之乐，凉夜去池里跳水。
叶子好像漂流，孩子们在花边跳起。
小青蛙高跃，勇敢孩子跳入软泡沫池。
暖风吹起，小羊在栏边蹦跳。
软球轻轻弹，正午在条纹帐篷边。
我们在离周日野餐布不远处搭小营火。
今早友好跑步时没人想猎鸟。
疲惫跑者跑完长马拉松，慢行人朋友挥手。
我们保持稳步伐，细心数每小步。
湖边短途游比孩子们长海轮游更好。
每次开心旅行都在家以甜蜜假日梦结束。
我们看朋友上坡远足，午饭前慢跑回来。
我们迈大步伐穿过高树唱低歌。
我们在洒满阳光的路上不久留不掉队。
我们帮奶奶爬山，再一起拉篮子。
壮手臂拖木头，酸痛的后背在炉边弯腰。
paraZh: 新生带着求学目标入学，结识师友并适应节奏。
迎新活动有趣，他调整作息并找到动力。
室友互助，他在学习和运动中进步。
他融入集体，在活动中建立自信。
他认真上课，认识了多位老师。
他备赛演讲，聆听嘉宾分享。
作为新生，他熟悉校园并完成注册。
他安顿住宿，开始实验和作业。
借阅科幻小说、记日记抄诗、买杂志做笔记，校园文化生活丰富多彩。
翻百科全书、记学习档案、写自我简介、画房间草图、修自行车、查索引目录，自主学习技能全面展开。
分类零食建清单、预习课文抓语境、列动词表复习语法、调低音量攻难题、选定主辅修专业，时间管理与专业规划同步推进。
他体验多门学科，度过充实一周。
画几何图解代数题、预习微积分看图表、核对金额对总数，数理思训练扎实推进。
新生期末周林梅结伴复习定计划。
山姆画图分工雨夜坚持学习。
物理焦虑中互助称量希望。
灯下取暖社团领袖带来安慰。
咖啡提神抄写公式互相鼓励。
确立制度迎接忙碌秋课收尾。
查漏补缺练背诵迎接大考。
诚信应考抓住每课要点。
整理引用搭建知识框架。
大胆假设细心观察保持清醒。
坚持理解互助解惑迎接春天。
对比包容中确认进步。
自信解开心结社团招新忙。
表彰成长珍惜情谊迎接新员。
周一博物馆开场讲文明与待客。
小镇居民热情，匠心守护遗产。
周二展厅仪式与礼仪之美。
信仰建筑与古帝国故事。
帝王将相与乡愁名人。
市集起伏与文字小游戏。
周三语言角开场练语音。
字母词汇与词典短句。
造词与词性小练习。
复述讲述与灯下解读。
周四讨论协商与媒体人物。
传播好消息、预见晴天、期待快乐与朋友，积极心态迎接周五欢聚。
等待微笑、甜美消遣填满温暖夜晚，美好期待化作现实。
周六午后马戏戏剧音乐会。
夜晚影像与画室舞台。
展览收集与画像描绘。
周日清晨多种歌曲风格。
湖边乐器合奏。
市中心友好比赛与志愿者。
晨练瑜伽与毯上拉伸。
室内球类与门框球拍。
轻动作投掷与冰雪滑动。
池边跳跃与营地野餐。
晨跑马拉松与湖海出游。
漫步回家收尾。

title: 衣食住行
zh: 旧物店与老屋餐厅，两卷读完。
paragraphs: Morning light fills my small old shop, for every [[stuff:stuff]] and used [[merchandise:merchandise]] holds a past life.
A girl brings a worn travel [[souvenir:souvenir]] and a clay [[artifact:artifact]] from her kind grandmother.
I check the [[raw:raw]] wood and [[crude:crude]] joints first, then plan each gentle repair step.
Warm coats are a winter [[necessity:necessity]], so I darn her torn festival [[outfit:outfit]] today.
I open my repair [[kit:kit]] and lift each small chrome [[utensil:utensil]] with slow care.
People call these things roadside [[rubbish:rubbish]], but I [[reuse:reuse]] them into gifts full of warmth.
This bent board came from a [[junk:junk]] pile near the old city [[landfill:landfill]] edge.
After the street [[sewerage:sewerage]] work, dust covered it, so I wash it with mild [[detergent:detergent]].
A caregiver gives me hand [[lotion:lotion]] and a low wide [[tub:tub]] for soaking dirty cloth.
I pull the small [[plug:plug]] and run the old [[tap:tap]] to rinse the frame clean.
A short zinc [[pipe:pipe]] and a soft hollow [[tube:tube]] join the legs firmly together.
I clean the floor with a wet [[mop:mop]] and an old straw [[broom:broom]] before starting work.
An old man brings a thin torn [[mattress:mattress]] and a dusty rolled [[carpet:carpet]].
His small flowered [[rug:rug]] and door [[mat:mat]] need fresh edges and bright new color.
I fill each flat seat [[cushion:cushion]] with a soft feather [[pad:pad]] for snugness.
His baby's blue [[blanket:blanket]] and cherished wedding [[quilt:quilt]] smell of long sunshine years.
A yellowed [[pillow:pillow]] was washed and the marks scrubbed with a soft [[sponge:sponge]].
It was dried with a thick white [[towel:towel]] and the label clipped with one small [[staple:staple]].
Each loose old [[nail:nail]] was pulled and loose edges cut with a sharp [[razor:razor]].
The rough corners were [[shave:shave]]d smooth and the faulty safety [[fuse:fuse]] changed.
A black power [[cable:cable]] and a long white [[cord:cord]] dangle behind the desk.
I twirl each loose wire [[strand:strand]] firmly, then light a small honey [[candle:candle]].
Warm [[wax:wax]] drips softly while I read repair tips from an old [[paperback:paperback]].
A picture [[pamphlet:pamphlet]] shows old crafts, and I keep small parts in soft [[tissue:tissue]].
I [[xerox:xerox]] the old invoice and place the short [[memorandum:memorandum]] above my desk.
My drawer of old [[stationery:stationery]] is messy, but the strong [[glue:glue]] still works well.
Blue [[ink:ink]] marks my notebook while a thick [[rubber:rubber]] band holds the pages.
With large silver [[scissors:scissors]] I [[shear:shear]] the thick cloth along the white line.
The round chair [[rim:rim]] is loose, yet each carved [[element:element]] stays truly beautiful.
Cost is one small [[factor:factor]], so I repair only the worst damaged [[section:section]].
I shine his old school [[badge:badge]] and tighten each tiny silver [[bolt:bolt]].
A round door [[knob:knob]] and a curved drawer [[handle:handle]] need gentle fixing today.
The battered window [[shutter:shutter]] shakes, while the long flowered [[curtain:curtain]] hangs down.
I renew the cracked window [[pane:pane]] because its cloudy [[opacity:opacity]] blocks warm light.
Buttons sleep in a glass [[jar:jar]] and old hooks rest inside a small [[barrel:barrel]].
I carry water with a red [[bucket:bucket]] and rinse brushes in a small enamel [[pail:pail]].
The shop [[phone:phone]] rings twice, then the little door [[bell:bell]] sings merrily.
My [[portable:portable]] lamp is handy, but the bright work [[spotlight:spotlight]] shows each defect.
An old paper [[lantern:lantern]] glows softly after I change its little warm [[bulb:bulb]].
My pocket [[flashlight:flashlight]] helps me see behind the humming old [[refrigerator:refrigerator]].
The small [[fridge:fridge]] hums while I inhale dust with the loud [[vacuum:vacuum]].
A worn delivery [[hurdle:hurdle]] and a fallen garden fence wait behind the shop.
I oil the loose bike [[pedal:pedal]] and straighten the long leaning wall [[shelf:shelf]].
I climb my short red [[ladder:ladder]] to reach the high three-legged painting [[stool:stool]].
A torn black [[umbrella:umbrella]] and a yellowed child's [[raincoat:raincoat]] drip by the door.
I [[dredge:dredge]] old paint from the dish and pour it into a rusty enamel [[can:can]].
The old chrome [[mill:mill]] is closed, so I warm the joints at a neighbor's small [[forge:forge]].
This light mixed [[alloy:alloy]] frame is softer than pure strong [[metal:metal]].
An old flat [[iron:iron]] stands beside a shining candlestick of yellow [[brass:brass]].
A small green [[bronze:bronze]] horse and a bag of grey [[cement:cement]] sit together.
White powdered [[lime:lime]] and smooth wall [[plaster:plaster]] repair the cracked corner well.
A cracked brown [[leather:leather]] bag and a clear [[plastic:plastic]] cover wait for care.
Each plant [[fibre:fibre]] feels rough, while the soft blue [[fabric:fabric]] feels smooth.
Grandma loves to [[knit:knit]] warm caps, and I [[weave:weave]] the torn seat again.
A thick painted [[canvas:canvas]] sheet and a white table [[linen:linen]] cover the worktop.
Soft white [[cotton:cotton]] shirts and a strong blue [[nylon:nylon]] bag dangle outdoors.
Fresh cut [[lumber:lumber]] smells sweet, and each wooden leg shines after oiling.
A date [[pit:pit]] lies near the heater, where wood gives steady winter [[fuel:fuel]].
I [[lubricate:lubricate]] each stiff hinge, then suspend a clear shining [[crystal:crystal]] pendant.
No [[inferior:inferior]] parts stay here, and every [[counterfeit:counterfeit]] coin goes back.
A [[fake:fake]] pearl breaks fast, for its thin painted shell is quite [[fragile:fragile]].
A tiny [[miniature:miniature]] chair model is the only gift still [[available:available]] today.
Strong seams make repairs [[durable:durable]] and slowly win the neighbors' warm [[popularity:popularity]].
Short capes are in [[vogue:vogue]], but warm snugness will always [[prevail:prevail]] here.
A young singer [[idol:idol]] loves plain dress, not flashy shop [[luxury:luxury]].
No [[extravagant:extravagant]] spending is needed when old family [[jewellery:jewellery]] shines anew.
Each tiny bright [[jewel:jewel]] and polished blue [[gem:gem]] glows in the dish.
A pale green [[jade:jade]] ring will [[adorn:adorn]] the old music box cover.
Every small gold [[ornament:ornament]] will [[embellish:embellish]] the plain festival dress.
I [[embroider:embroider]] red flowers while my sister practices gentle wedding [[hairdressing:hairdressing]].
Natural green [[pigment:pigment]] and a safe brown [[dye:dye]] color the pale cloth.
For the spring [[masquerade:masquerade]] play, she wears a thin shining [[veil:veil]].
Her old dance [[costume:costume]] will [[fascinate:fascinate]] every child in front.
A [[decent:decent]] clean hem looks good, and neat buttons add an [[exquisite:exquisite]] touch.
She walks with gentle [[grace:grace]] and quiet simple [[elegance:elegance]] each day.
Her neat new [[appearance:appearance]] needs no costly shop [[cosmetics:cosmetics]] at all.
Light soft [[makeup:makeup]] keeps her sweet [[charming:charming]] smile through the day.
We [[clothe:clothe]] the child warmly and repair each torn school [[garment:garment]].
Fresh folded [[laundry:laundry]] fills her small tidied bedroom [[wardrobe:wardrobe]] again.
His work [[overall:overall]] is dusty, so he borrows a long grey [[overcoat:overcoat]].
A soft morning [[robe:robe]] and a long evening [[gown:gown]] dangle behind the screen.
I repair a blue winter [[sweater:sweater]] and a brown biking [[jacket:jacket]].
His grey work [[trousers:trousers]] need a strong button and a small silver [[clasp:clasp]].
I shape the bent hat [[brim:brim]] and wash a soft flowered [[scarf:scarf]].
A white dotted [[handkerchief:handkerchief]] and a small buttoned [[purse:purse]] lie together.
I keep a brown worn [[wallet:wallet]] and a grey sleeveless [[vest:vest]].
I [[wrap:wrap]] the gift neatly and dangle her dark theatre [[cloak:cloak]] inside.
A white shirt [[collar:collar]] is bent, and one long coat [[sleeve:sleeve]] is short.
One warm winter [[sock:sock]] and a thin party [[stocking:stocking]] need pairs.
Her pink soft [[slipper:slipper]] is worn, but its white edging [[lace:lace]] stays pretty.
The kind old [[tailor:tailor]] will [[sew:sew]] the hem before the evening show.
We [[spin:spin]] the yarn smoothly and add one strong hidden [[stitch:stitch]].
My sharp chrome [[needle:needle]] flashes, and each colored [[pin:pin]] holds the pleat.
A long red [[string:string]] and a thin white [[thread:thread]] lie beside the roller.
A torn bag [[strap:strap]] hangs loose, while a painted wall [[stripe:stripe]] guides my cut.
A pink satin [[ribbon:ribbon]] ties the box, and a black school [[belt:belt]] needs holes.
A thin gold [[chain:chain]] shines beside her small new [[bracelet:bracelet]].
Her old pearl [[necklace:necklace]] broke, so I renew each tiny fallen [[bead:bead]].
Old saved [[textile:textile]] scraps and a piece of red [[velvet:velvet]] fill the box.
Soft grey sheep [[wool:wool]] and a flowered knee [[patch:patch]] save the old coat.
A torn cleaning [[rag:rag]] wipes the worktop in our [[shabby:shabby]] but cozy corner.
The [[tight:tight]] belt is eased, and a calm deep [[purple:purple]] shade hides the repair.
A soft [[tan:tan]] coat is cleaned so its warm color will never [[fade:fade]].
Each dark food [[stain:stain]] and each paint [[blot:blot]] slowly leaves the cloth.
The tall happy [[figure:figure]] tests the fixed dress with a [[slender:slender]] smile.
At dusk we share tea, thankful for each [[slight:slight]] repair that warms our street.
Grandma announced a new [[erection:erection]] plan, ignoring every past [[stricture:stricture]] about money.
Mom agreed to [[construct:construct]] a warm dining hall, though old dust could [[obstruct:obstruct]] ruin dinner.
Mingming wanted to [[establish:establish]] clear duties, starting with washing the gray [[concrete:concrete]] floor.
Uncle Wang brought bright [[steel:steel]] tools, ensuring strength and long [[stability:stability]] for shelves.
They walked around the dusty [[site:site]], dreaming how the future [[venue:venue]] would welcome guests.
The old house was a village [[landmark:landmark]], quietly [[situated:situated]] beside green trees and narrow paths.
Mom tried to [[locate:locate]] old drawings where grandpa once chose to [[reside:reside]] and cook.
Small birds still [[inhabit:inhabit]] the roof, but they will [[migrate:migrate]] elsewhere after noise begins.
Grandma decided to [[settle:settle]] downstairs, keeping the whole [[dwelling:dwelling]] lively day and night.
Mingming laughed that their home was no [[skyscraper:skyscraper]] or rich [[villa:villa]], yet full of love.
Unlike a cold [[mansion:mansion]] or crowded [[apartment:apartment]], this place kept childhood memories alive.
They refused to make it into a noisy [[hostel:hostel]] or hunting [[lodge:lodge]] for strangers.
Behind the yard stood a weak [[hut:hut]] and a wooden [[cabin:cabin]] full of battered chairs.
Mom opened the dark [[cellar:cellar]] and the leaning [[shed:shed]], coughing through thick dust.
The small [[cottage:cottage]] next door once served as a daytime [[nursery:nursery]] for village kids.
Mingming found his tiny [[cradle:cradle]] there, now a safe [[shelter:shelter]] for kittens.
Uncle Wang moved each fallen [[block:block]] and drew a neat cleaning [[grid:grid]] on paper.
They swept a narrow [[aisle:aisle]] first, then cleared leaves across the wide [[porch:porch]].
Dust covered the long [[corridor:corridor]], while spider webs hung along the shaky [[staircase:staircase]].
The upper [[storey:storey]] held a thick [[layer:layer]] of ash that made everyone sneeze loudly.
Mingming joked about missing an [[escalator:escalator]], gripping the loose wooden [[handrail:handrail]] tightly.
Grandma wiped one stone [[pillar:pillar]] after another, counting each tall [[column:column]] aloud.
A cracked wooden [[beam:beam]] held up the curved [[vault:vault]] above the main hall.
Mom praised the round [[arch:arch]] and the high [[ceiling:ceiling]] that kept summer air cool.
Sparrows nested under wide [[eaves:eaves]], near the tall stone [[chimney:chimney]] full of soot.
They planned a simple [[reception:reception]] corner, brighter than any hotel [[lobby:lobby]] in town.
The rickety wooden [[bench:bench]] left the old [[parlour:parlour]] looking empty and sad.
Grandma kept the stone [[fireplace:fireplace]] but removed the rusty iron [[radiator:radiator]] beside it.
Mingming cleaned the dusty [[living room:living room]] shelves, polishing every wooden [[cabinet:cabinet]] door.
Mom opened the sunny [[balcony:balcony]] doors, sweeping dry leaves off the stone [[terrace:terrace]].
The old [[kitchen:kitchen]] smelled of smoke, worse than the forgotten back [[lavatory:lavatory]] nearby.
Uncle Wang scrubbed the yellowed [[toilet:toilet]] seat, then wiped the stained [[bath:bath]] tub edge.
Unlike the noisy town [[mall:mall]] or stone shopping [[complex:complex]], home felt calm.
They listed needed items, skipping the distant [[supermarket:supermarket]] and night market [[booth:booth]].
Nobody wanted a flashy [[casino:casino]] or noisy photo [[studio:studio]]; they wanted warm meals.
Though town development felt strongly [[urban:urban]], their alley stayed quiet like a [[peripheral:peripheral]] dream.
Shops in the near [[vicinity:vicinity]] closed early, leaving the night street an empty [[void:void]].
After clearing junk, the hall looked [[spacious:spacious]] yet dusty, far from [[airtight:airtight]] and safe.
Mingming ran across the wide [[expanse:expanse]] toward the small front [[plaza:plaza]], shouting with pleasure.
He imagined the house as a storybook [[castle:castle]], then watched the old [[carpenter:carpenter]] appear.
The careful [[mason:mason]] tapped each loose floor [[tile:tile]], humming an old village tune.
By sunset, fresh gray [[brickwork:brickwork]] along the doorway promised many busy mornings ahead.
Mingming woke with a sharp [[appetite:appetite]], impatient to help Mom [[cater:cater]] for tomorrow guests.
They checked stored [[provision:provision]] bags, keeping only fresh [[edible:edible]] food for cooking.
Grandma shared a secret [[recipe:recipe]], planning to make the old hall into a small [[restaurant:restaurant]].
Unlike the school [[refectory:refectory]] or noisy street [[bar:bar]], home food would taste gentle.
They refused dull [[cafeteria:cafeteria]] lines and a costly hotel [[buffet:buffet]] for the inaugural.
Uncle Wang offered his yard [[barbecue:barbecue]] stand, freeing the family [[supper:supper]] from dull routines.
Grandma dreamed of a harvest [[banquet:banquet]], with warm tea [[refreshment:refreshment]] for every child.
Mingming packed a quick [[snack:snack]] and a tiny first [[appetiser:appetiser]] for the road.
Mom praised village [[cuisine:cuisine]], refusing greasy street [[takeaway:takeaway]] boxes that night.
A retired [[chef:chef]] nearby smiled, calling Mingming a little [[gourmet:gourmet]] with refined taste.
They also cooked for a [[vegetarian:vegetarian]] aunt, borrowing clean extra [[cutlery:cutlery]] from neighbors.
Mom sliced a thin [[sliver:sliver]] of melon, serving soup in blue [[ceramic:ceramic]] bowls.
Grandma lifted white [[porcelain:porcelain]] plates, placing a small flower [[saucer:saucer]] beneath each cup.
Mingming carried a wooden [[tray:tray]] and a warm milk [[mug:mug]] without spilling a bit.
Mom filled the black [[kettle:kettle]] and scrubbed the deep iron [[pot:pot]] until shiny.
Uncle Wang checked the old [[stove:stove]] flames, cleaning the cold brick [[furnace:furnace]] behind it.
They warmed bread in the clay [[oven:oven]] and stored rice in a sealed [[tin:tin]].
Mingming pressed the loose jar [[lid:lid]] tight, pouring hot pear [[beverage:beverage]] for grandma.
They refused strong [[alcohol:alcohol]] and cheap fruit [[liquor:liquor]] at the family table.
Uncle Wang hid his [[whisky:whisky]] bottle and his sweet [[brandy:brandy]] from inquisitive kids.
Nobody arrived [[drunk:drunk]] for dinner, though old [[tobacco:tobacco]] smell lingered in coats.
Grandma threw away a wet [[cigarette:cigarette]] end, keeping her head clear and [[sober:sober]].
At dawn they picked green [[pea:pea]] pods and crisp long [[cucumber:cucumber]] in the garden.
Mom chose round [[cabbage:cabbage]] heads and shiny purple [[eggplant:eggplant]] for stew.
Mingming pulled orange [[carrot:carrot]] roots and flat white [[turnip:turnip]] heads from soft soil.
He washed each small [[radish:radish]] clean, then helped grandma [[peel:peel]] apples for lunch.
Mom taught him to [[strip:strip]] wilted leaves, keeping the soft yellow [[core:core]] inside.
They cracked the rough seed [[hull:hull]], tasting one red wild [[berry:berry]] after another.
Mingming traded purple [[grape:grape]] bunches for two soft sweet [[papaya:papaya]] fruits.
Grandma dried red [[plum:plum]] slices, thanking the autumn [[crop:crop]] for lavish gifts.
Uncle Wang carried golden [[corn:corn]] ears and heavy [[grain:grain]] sacks into the yard.
They ground pale [[wheat:wheat]] kernels, remembering how farmers [[reap:reap]] under hot sun.
Mom mixed white [[flour:flour]] with water, cooking thick morning [[porridge:porridge]] for all.
Mingming stirred sticky rice [[paste:paste]], watching inquisitive village [[livestock:livestock]] near fences.
They chose a fat village [[chicken:chicken]] and a stately brown [[turkey:turkey]] for the feast.
Mom bought prime pink [[beef:beef]] slices and low-fat fresh [[pork:pork]] from a trusted vendor.
Grandma seasoned dark [[mutton:mutton]] chunks, adding a long smoked [[sausage:sausage]] for flavor.
Uncle Wang netted a silver [[fish:fish]] from the clear [[pond:pond]] behind bamboo groves.
He carved a new fishing [[rod:rod]], trading fresh milk [[dairy:dairy]] foods with neighbors.
Mingming tasted thick white [[yogurt:yogurt]] and spread soft yellow [[butter:butter]] on bread.
They shared a warm [[hamburger:hamburger]] bun and a crusty brown [[loaf:loaf]] at noon.
Mom baked a round apple [[pie:pie]] and boiled thin long [[pasta:pasta]] for kids.
Grandma twirled long [[spaghetti:spaghetti]] strands, chilling sweet milk [[pudding:pudding]] for dessert.
Mingming crunched a square [[biscuit:biscuit]] and spread red strawberry [[jam:jam]] thickly.
They churned cold [[ice cream:ice cream]] bowls, adding fragrant pale [[vanilla:vanilla]] drops.
Mom passed strong yellow [[mustard:mustard]] and a tiny green [[wasabi:wasabi]] dab carefully.
Uncle Wang crushed black [[pepper:pepper]] corns, slicing pale yellow [[ginger:ginger]] root thinly.
Mingming minced white [[garlic:garlic]] cloves and long green [[scallion:scallion]] stalks for soup.
They sprinkled clear rice [[vinegar:vinegar]] drops, pinching white [[salt:salt]] crystals lightly.
Grandma loved the mild fruit [[flavour:flavour]], not the sharp [[sour:sour]] taste from unripe plums.
Mingming spat out the [[bitter:bitter]] skin, reaching instead for mild [[spicy:spicy]] warm soup.
Guests called the stew [[delicious:delicious]] and the warm buns [[yummy:yummy]] beyond words.
The hot noodles tasted [[tasty:tasty]], perfect for [[thirsty:thirsty]] workers after long labor.
Mom ground red [[spice:spice]] powder, simmering thick tomato [[sauce:sauce]] slowly.
Mingming squeezed red [[ketchup:ketchup]] lines, while roses gave natural [[perfume:perfume]] nearby.
Grandma counted each fresh [[ingredient:ingredient]], adding a herbal health [[supplement:supplement]] for elders.
Warm soup helps elders [[digest:digest]] well, so mom chose to [[bake:bake]] soft cakes instead.
Uncle Wang helped [[fry:fry]] golden potato shreds, then watched grandma [[roast:roast]] chestnuts slowly.
They served crisp morning [[toast:toast]], warning kids not to [[suck:suck]] hot soup quickly.
Mingming learned to [[swallow:swallow]] calmly, refusing to [[lick:lick]] fingers at the table.
He promised not to [[chew:chew]] loudly, blowing cool air on mint [[gum:gum]] after meals.
Mom told him to [[soak:soak]] dry mushrooms, then briefly [[dip:dip]] greens in boiling water.
Grandma taught Mingming to [[squeeze:squeeze]] oranges and gently [[stir:stir]] honey into tea.
At last mom began to [[grind:grind]] sesame seeds, filling the yard with nutty fragrance.
They hung paper lamps with thin [[suspension:suspension]] cords, tying each knot with an iron [[hook:hook]].
Mingming pulled the wooden [[lever:lever]], steadying the tall bamboo [[scaffold:scaffold]] for uncle.

paraZh: 清晨小店开门，女孩送来旧物，修补匠备好工具。
木板架子清洗组装，店面打扫干净。
洗枕头擦污渍、毛巾擦干夹标签，居家整理细致入微。
拔旧钉剪松边、刮平角落换保险丝，维修技能熟练运用。
单据文具收拾好，剪布修椅看花费。
门窗小件和零碎收纳，提水备洗。
电话门铃响起，灯具家电逐一检修。
杂物修补：车架梯凳雨具，漆罐接头金属架。
金属粉料皮塑布料上手，奶奶织帽我编椅。
布料木料炉火水晶齐备，劣质假货不留。
小件礼物耐穿赢口碑，流行偶像奢华观。
珠宝盒饰品装点，绣花发型颜料舞会。
舞衣体面优雅，淡妆暖衣待客。
衣柜工装晨袍晚裙，裤帽围巾齐整。
手帕钱包背心斗篷，领袖袜鞋配齐。
裁缝纺针线，包带条纹缎带齐活。
金链珠饰丝绒羊毛收尾，腰身紫色遮痕。
去渍试衣，黄昏喝茶暖街。
奶奶宣布重开老屋饭厅全家开始分工清扫
妈妈找图纸小鸟暂住众人定下守住老屋的决心
清理后院棚屋发现摇篮画好清扫分区
擦洗走廊楼梯扶手和大厅穹顶
布置迎客角擦亮客厅柜门
收拾阳台露台厨房厕所并列出采买清单
拒绝改成赌场照相馆大厅变宽敞
跑向广场迎接木匠泥瓦匠门口砌好砖墙
明明饿醒帮忙备餐定下开小饭馆的目标
退休厨师夸明明为素食姨妈借餐具切瓜
拿出瓷盘托盘水壶铁锅土烤箱和梨汁
不喝酒不抽烟清晨摘豆摘瓜挑菜
拔萝卜削苹果剥籽壳换木瓜晒李子
扛玉米磨麦子煮粥搅米糊选鸡选肉
调羊肉网银鱼换奶品尝酸奶分面包烤派
卷面条冰布丁抹果酱搅冰淇淋切姜剁蒜
洒醋捏盐辨果香喝辣汤熬番茄酱
挤酱数食材熬汤炸薯条烤面包学餐桌礼仪
饭后嚼口香糖泡蘑菇烫青菜挤橙汁磨芝麻
挂灯笼扶脚手架运器械修风扇补桌布改菜单
焊接椅凳拧螺丝学组装桥梁装灯摆碗

成本不断攀升，他不敢把店面扩到隔壁。
附近年轻人突然涌入，不暗示整条街很快变富。
他想丰富早餐种类，却没有足够地方放新货架。
后屋勉强够用，也没有多余椅子给客人休息。
微薄的存款维持着灯火，旧箱子在角落成了多余之物。
缺人手让他筋疲力尽，直到隔壁小公司来搭把手。
那家小企业派来和气的人，商量共同早晨送货。
作为单打独斗的人，没有家人支持他不敢多投钱。
听了邻居实在的意见，他认真挑好每件早货。
一次冒险进的便宜冬货，把后屋堆到屋顶。
冬天运来的货物晚到了，他忘了给易碎箱子保价。
司机再三保证，下次一定派更可靠沉稳的人来。
长久商谈之后，老林请教子每晚都来旁听。
定大米最终售价那晚，桌边一个人也没缺席。
他们争论批发价，还开玩笑说天亮摆摊卖豆子。
供货商报了低价，老林怀着希望拍板成交。
每笔买卖都记下来，定期在周日结算营业额。
他们保证不丢烂菜，也不把麻烦推给别街。
他们约定每周按限额进新鲜水果，有危险一起担。
没有银行利息牵扯，也没答应给外人十二个月分红。
老林把剩货记进本子，另开一本账管日常。
他先留下一点定金，余下定期分期付清。
他数清每一枚小钱，擦亮旧铜罐做摆设。
出租人说老房产一带很快会有新店入驻。
老林希望小店成为家传，日子长久安宁。
他觉得辛苦很值得，每个邻居都像金子般宝贵。
一点盈利的鼓舞，让他想把开幕提早一小时。
他招呼利落讨人喜欢，留着硬币给店员发薪水。
微薄的进项还够喝汤，也够付小帮工的日工资。
饭馆晚付货款，逼得他向供货商要一点退款。
他很快报销车费，工资本却锁在抽屉里。
没有额外报酬，但街道补贴帮他付了冬灯费。
他想慢慢挣得信任，把小店当一辈子事业珍惜。
看店是朴素的行当，也是全家体面的职业。
他把它当成天职，天亮到天黑都出实在力气。
三个帮工的小队伍，笑着说他是温和的拼命人。
店里人个个和气，年轻店员记得每个孩子的名字。
每次面谈，他都就着热茶细看手写简历。
邻居推荐老实青年，他都乐意多收一个帮手。
他发誓不在怒气中招人，不在雨天开除人。
从不突然裁员吓人，也不赶走生病的孩子。
他只清理碎掉的箱子，从不强迫人丢脸辞职。
他从不用面袋当椅子，还说笑自己不早退。
一次送货失败，像打碎了他所有早晨计划。
鲜奶突然断货，给对手散布难听话的机会。
老林没机会详述，只能在沉默和争吵之间选择。
他想平心静气解决问题，保住和供货商的长久往来。
他努力管住情绪，放缓呼吸听刺耳的抱怨。
街规拦不住吵闹，朋友们只好来协调谈话。
双方答应合作一晚，一起对账查本子。
年轻学生讲解法律字句，把冰冷条例读了两遍。
老口头约定太松，不如老林手里的纸约可靠。
墙上的店规和司机留的送货规矩对不上。
晚送打破了行规，也低于他们定的底线。
鲜奶啥算合格没写清，也从没定过统一标准。
司机请求先开口，勉强承认自己晚了。
老林说要信守每个承诺，严守早晨送货时间。
烂瓶他一律拒收，黎明时间卡得很紧。
街道干部说早送是食品店必须守的规矩。
浓茶提神，两人都讲情义愿心平气和谈。
老林说对孩子有责任，怕丢脸走上公堂。
不用惊动大人物，街道会定简单的共用规矩。
他们不想立苛刻条文，只求小店之间大致公平。
对新人的旧偏见散了，当晚没人搞歧视。
老林不再发怒指责，保证不为一车货打官司。
没人想告疲惫的司机，也不忍责备他家人。
抵制的话不提了，大家喝着热茶静静开会。
梅姨来温和调解，平静听完每个疲惫的诉说。
老林软语求信任，却没有生硬反驳司机。
她努力劝和双方，给变质牛奶的争执降温。
屋里掠过紧张的低语，司机开始嘟囔道歉。
理解的轻声蔓延，连生气的叔伯都安静沉默。
他们答应查清晚到的车，向路上见证人问实情。
事实会证明谁有理，也撑起新的送货安排。
梅姨挑了合适时间，不请严厉的人来断案。
旧怒慢慢化了，不用开庭也能治好伤口。
没人再是嫌疑人，纸上也没写严厉的判语。
那晚没人被抓，也没人面对冰冷的牢房。
对黑屋的惊恐散了，谈话不只停在纸上。
梅姨愿盯着早晨到货，天天亲自查牛奶。
他们约定少接夜单，不在孩子面前大吵。
双方答应存善心，除了晚车不再有亏心事。
街上没有寒冷的案件，小店后面也没有藏着歪心。
没人在黑夜行贿，也没人抢朋友的功劳。
夜里没有贼碰货架，帮工也不偷罐里硬币。
贼和命案的话题，离热茶微笑很远很远。
绝望没走到绝路，也没人再骗老朋友。
店里不用掺水奶骗人，也不藏微笑后的骗局。
没人再被骂骗子，新约里也没藏苦陷阱。
不用耍小聪明，也不用装欢快喝热茶。
没人觉得自己傻，司机一家甩掉了旧骂名。
司机决定公开承认晚点，服从新的黎明规矩。
老林乐意彻底和好，遵守那晚定的共行计划。
双方都不再屈从面子，也不再受重罚。
重罚单没开，小店也没押出去。
店面归属仍是老林，手绘招牌也留着简朴款。
为街坊服务是安静的福气，邻居都认他的实心。
一张小纸条帮他们找到城外新鲜农场。
没匿名纸条再传怒气，假话也进不了店。
真诚笑容回到老林脸上，早晨的流程也有了章法。
天天打扫成了平静习惯，善举都带来暖报。
硬性要求压不住善意，尖声也不再打破安宁。
新规矩不费多少钱，只请各家签下共同信。
梅姨不像头儿那样下令，只用故事轻声教帮工。
paraZh: 我们在家收拾行李，父亲带我去排队办签证，屋里屋外都是出发前的忙碌。
签证有了着落，我们住进小店，父亲核对材料，商量乘车的事。
清晨登上列车，车厢温暖，父亲指着窗外讲沿途的山河。
列车穿过平原，阳光正好，我们和邻座分享吃食，有说有欢。
中午到达边境，市集热闹，父亲带我下车走走，看看异乡风物。
进入第二国后，田野开阔，夜里灯光明亮，旅途格外安稳。
傍晚停车时，我们认识了新朋友，大家围坐一起谈天。
夜深了，车厢安静，父亲轻声讲过去的事，哄我入睡。
清晨雾气未散，列车继续向前，父亲带我看日出。
上午经过大河，桥很长，水面发亮，我们都趴在窗边看。
中午在小站停靠，我们买了热汤，味道鲜美，暖了全身。
下午穿过村庄，孩子们挥手，父亲也挥手回应。
进入第三国时，已是黄昏，灯火渐渐亮起，街景新鲜。
晚上住进旅馆，父亲打开新闻，画面里正在谈论选举。
新闻里选情激烈，父亲结合一路见闻，给我讲其中的道理。
邻座旅客也来讨论，大家看法不同，但聊得很和气。
深夜回到车厢，父亲总结几国的见闻，说世界很大。
回程的清晨，阳光温柔，我们整理行李，准备回家。
车过平原，春花开放，父亲说回家要把故事讲给家人听。
中午短暂停留，我们买了点心，分给同车的孩子。
下午离家渐近，熟悉的山水出现，心里格外踏实。
傍晚到家，母亲迎出来，一家人围坐吃饭，旅途圆满结束。

老林想开街角小店，筹备中满是生计压力。
邻里交换物件故事、保存收据防税费、了解关税强责任、担心高租吞噬积蓄，经济与法治意识并重。
担忧大地主高租吞噬积蓄，弱势者的生存焦虑真实呈现。
生意下滑后他省吃俭用，想办法稳住客流。
人手不够时隔壁企业伸手，带来合作机会。
他谨慎进货签约，请来侄子旁听谈判。
双方定价成交，约定新鲜和诚信。
账目定金理清，老林盼小店长久传家。
微利维持着工资和日常，日子紧巴却用心。
小店是全家骄傲，全员和气肯干。
招人重人品，承诺不轻易赶人。
一次断货引发谣言争吵，朋友出面缓和。
旧约模糊不清，新旧规矩对不上。
干部定下早送铁规，双方愿意心平气和谈。
大家放下偏见和官司念头，坐下喝茶开会。
梅姨温和调解，双方查清真相。
怒气消散，不走公堂也能愈合。
定下早查夜约，守善不沾歪邪。
谣言骗局远去，司机一家甩掉骂名。
双方认错和好，店权分明重获信任。
找到新农场货源，日子恢复平静安宁。
梅姨用故事教人，和解长久。

title: 历史与发明
zh: 战争纪念馆与发明比赛，两卷读完。
paragraphs: Last Sunday Grandpa said old wars brought deep [[violence:violence]] and long [[conflict:conflict]] to villages.
He told us a night [[raid:raid]] showed the [[enormity:enormity]] of torment behind brave talk.
The old winter [[campaign:campaign]] ended with one last [[battle:battle]] near the cold river.
My brother heard his quiet [[struggle:struggle]] and the loud [[explosion:explosion]] far beyond the hills.
Big guns would [[bombard:bombard]] the town while planes would [[bomb:bomb]] bridges at night.
Each loud [[blast:blast]] made windows burst and little kids cry under tables.
A tiny [[spark:spark]] by the stove still [[twinkle:twinkles]] in my grandpa's sad memory.
The smell of [[gunpowder:gunpowder]] rose around a ruined [[tank:tank]] left in the field.
A heavy [[cannon:cannon]] stood silent while a small [[missile:missile]] lay beside the path.
Grandpa put the old [[weapon:weapon]] and worn [[pistol:pistol]] back into a wooden box.
A rusty [[rifle:rifle]] rested near one [[bullet:bullet]] kept as sad sign of past days.
The old [[target:target]] on the wall helped shells [[deflect:deflect]] away from nearby homes.
His first [[mission:mission]] by the warm [[flame:flame]] of a lamp was to carry letters.
A red [[flare:flare]] rose while bits of [[glitter:glitter]] fell softly across the dark sky.
A soft [[glow:glow]] lit the [[blade:blade]] Grandpa cleaned slowly after supper.
He laid down his [[sword:sword]] and old [[axe:axe]] beside the quiet fireplace.
The small [[hammer:hammer]] fixed the [[bow:bow]] that played music on cold nights.
A bent [[arrow:arrow]] lay with a long [[spear:spear]] under dusty classroom pictures.
A cracked [[helmet:helmet]] stayed with a dented [[shield:shield]] above the school door.
Kind teachers helped [[equip:equip]] kids and [[prepare:prepare]] warm tea for tired guests.
The hall could [[provide:provide]] hot soup and [[deploy:deploy]] kind helpers at the gate.
A stone never [[hit:hit]] the wall nor did songs [[beat:beat]] away lonely fears.
No loud [[strike:strike]] was heard nor did fists [[punch:punch]] holes in thin doors.
Hands used to [[chop:chop]] wood would never [[stab:stab]] friends in ire.
That hard [[dilemma:dilemma]] left the whole family in lasting [[plight:plight]] for years.
Every hidden [[pitfall:pitfall]] grew from a cruel [[conspiracy:conspiracy]] of avid leaders.
Poor streets looked [[destitute:destitute]] while long [[famine:famine]] spread through the valley.
Thin kids would [[starve:starve]] when cold nights [[deprive:deprived]] them of warm meals.
Strong men came to [[seize:seize]] grain and [[pursue:pursue]] sad farmers down lanes.
Each new [[threat:threat]] would [[offend:offend]] calm folks who loved quiet country life.
No loud [[aggressive:aggressive]] shouts could [[invade:invade]] our small house of love.
No outsider could [[trespass:trespass]] past the fence nor [[intrude:intrude]] into our yard.
Kind rules must never be [[violate:violated]] even when noisy crowds [[attack:attack]] old peace.
The sudden [[assault:assault]] tested our word to [[challenge:challenge]] spite with calm words.
The long [[siege:siege]] failed to [[surround:surround]] the town with hunger and fright.
High walls could not [[enclose:enclose]] us through one long [[pause:pause]] in talks.
At last the guns would [[halt:halt]] and the sad songs would [[cease:cease]] slowly.
Brave mothers would [[oppose:oppose]] spite and crowds stopped to [[oppress:oppress]] the weak.
Wise talk could [[counter:counter]] fright and [[deter:deter]] young men from joining fights.
Old laws would [[forbid:forbid]] guns and city schools [[prohibit:prohibited]] games with knives.
Calm leaders tried to [[prevent:prevent]] loss while farmers began to [[revolt:revolt]] softly.
No son would [[betray:betray]] friends nor would [[treason:treason]] stain our family name.
One young [[rebel:rebel]] refused praise from a hired [[traitor:traitor]] across the river.
Each true [[patriot:patriot]] bore no [[blame:blame]] for the sad faults of leaders.
Soft [[reproach:reproach]] spoke louder than cold [[evidence:evidence]] laid upon the table.
Clear [[proof:proof]] ended idle [[terror:terror]] among kids who loved nightly stories.
The news was [[terrible:terrible]] yet the will for peace was [[terrific:terrific]] in hearts.
The [[horrible:horrible]] noise woke sharp [[alarm:alarm]] inside each tiny wooden house.
Deep [[dread:dread]] filled nights and loud booms used to [[frighten:frighten]] small dogs.
Long [[tension:tension]] grew in [[turbulent:turbulent]] days before quiet talks brought hope.
Passed [[turmoil:turmoil]] colored each true [[scenario:scenario]] shared inside the warm hall.
That special [[occasion:occasion]] taught respect for [[limit:limits]] on pride and ire.
The old [[boundary:boundary]] stones still kept the [[rein:rein]] on fidgety barnyard horses.
Teams no longer [[compete:compete]] in shooting [[contest:contests]] but in joyful harvest games.
Old foes learned to [[contend:contend]] kindly without letting [[rival:rival]] pride spoil spring work.
An ex-[[competitor:competitor]] now calls his old [[enemy:enemy]] a cherished close friend.
Good [[strategy:strategy]] needs wiser [[tactic:tactics]] than hasty guns and bitter cries.
Each clever [[manoeuvre:manoeuvre]] followed Grandpa's simple [[blueprint:blueprint]] for safe return home.
Grandpa would [[warn:warn]] kids and hunger did [[compel:compel]] mothers to sob softly.
Kind nurses felt [[oblige:obliged]] by duty to [[order:order]] bread for hungry mouths.
Their calm [[protest:protest]] helped [[refute:refute]] lies spread by distant radio stations.
True might lies not in cruel [[force:force]] but in gentle helping hands.
Warm food will [[reinforce:reinforce]] weak bodies and nothing can [[impair:impair]] kindly care.
Soft songs can [[mitigate:mitigate]] torment and bring [[comfort:comfort]] to lonely widows.
Each small [[event:event]] holds some [[matter:matter]] worthy of quiet adult thought.
Great change can [[happen:happen]] where kind deeds [[occur:occur]] daily around schools.
No [[savage:savage]] act seems [[reckless:reckless]] now beside Grandpa's gentle wrinkled smile.
His [[fierce:fierce]] cough sounds [[foul:foul]] in winter yet his heart stays kind.
No [[evil:evil]] thought serves the [[devil:devil]] who feeds upon angry quarrels.
Harsh [[punishment:punishment]] should never [[execute:execute]] boys who stole warm bread in hunger.
They did not [[hang:hang]] old coats but [[sacrifice:sacrifice]] sweet sleep to help neighbours.
Each lost [[casualty:casualty]] asks us to [[bury:bury]] pride along with rusty shells.
One silent [[funeral:funeral]] closed near a mossy [[grave:grave]] behind white poplars.
A plain [[tomb:tomb]] stands far from noisy [[hell:hell]] of smoky old fields.
Old [[maritime:maritime]] maps show [[naval:naval]] routes once used by worried sailors.
A quiet [[fleet:fleet]] sleeps while a tired [[troop:troop]] rests beside green pines.
No rough [[landing:landing]] shakes the cove where gulls [[hover:hover]] over blue waves.
Slow walkers [[proceed:proceed]] along stone steps while peace will [[progress:progress]] in hearts.
No [[military:military]] truck carries [[nuclear:nuclear]] loads through our blossoming apple orchards.

便宜的麦克风录下声音，旁边是装歌的老磁带盒。
胶带把电线粘紧，二进制代码在小屏上闪。
无线连接正常，池塘的高清图片很清楚。
清晰的音频让大家听见，共同的愿景让团队勇敢平静。
他们的幻想像关于清水河的科幻故事一样奔放。
手压泵抽起池水，小发电机点亮小灯。
每个塑料齿轮很牢，底座能向太阳转动。
没有液压油漏，学校排水沟整周都干爽。
脏污水隔开，新鲜通风让小棚气味清新。
湿叶会被压缩，蒸汽在冷盖上冷凝。
每道缝隙被尝试修整，管子被简化以便日常护理。
灰水会被净化，汤渣会被过滤用于菜床。
饮用水未被蒸馏；那种模式需要更多热量和时间。
第三个原型立在大门旁的轻木架上。
每个方面都好看，只有一个阶段夜里还漏。
老陈教学生操作水嘴，让早检更顺利。
他们能转化沟水，供花坛使用。
他们没改屋顶水道，只挪罐子收集雨水。
黄昏时全组转动阀门，为口渴的根调水。
他们调小螺丝，用粉笔标出滴水点。
三天平静试验后读数又准又精。
每个正确的配件都节水，每处改好的错误都教人细心。
小失误暴露了左下接缝的细裂纹。
欢迎回家的牌子鼓舞工人，微笑遮住小故障。
李被松动的石头绊了一下，很快修好这个意外。
在艰难情况下老海员仍是大家真正的先驱。
没有大声的预言者许诺胜利，但和善的传令者夸他们稳。
老人让梅管罐子做继承人，让兰管笔记做接班人。
三代学生加入，一起写共用的姓氏名单。
没人问性别，学生和配偶帮手任务一样。
和善的老祖父和疲惫的岳父搬起重罐。
每个兄弟姐妹带堂表亲每天午后刷瓶子。
小侄子涛慢慢倒，侄女安娜高举漏斗。
他们看豆胚醒来，像虚弱婴儿睁大眼睛。
流浪小狗是个小孤儿，跟着每个少年帮手去棚里。
每个年轻人都分面包，青春歌声让正午明亮。
没有喧闹的帮伙挡路，青少年志愿者每天扫巷。
明亮的青春期里他们学了很多，亲戚在旁帮忙。
乡亲们停下看，远方亲戚寄来种子。
夜里亲密的谈话变多，感谢米茶情意深。
小莹是大家的心肝，给每位爱花人端凉茶。
敬爱的林夫人老师夸接头整齐、双手沉稳。
笑盈盈的女主人倒茶，严厉的女房东洗杯。
院子的女主人和忙碌的家庭主妇一起拖地。
苏寡妇缝布袋，手脚麻利的女仆冲罐子。
首次试验通过，让疲惫的全家傍晚开心。
有风趣的主持人带唱，每件讨厌的杂活都轻了。
白发的房东借出棚子，新房客打扫干净。
每位客人喝到干净茶，每位顾客都夸水清。
害羞的客户提问，短暂相遇带来更多帮助。
学生们修滴水时不追野狗，不误午饭。
每次和评委约见后，梅都陪林走到门口。
拄拐的小波仍靠人照顾，却敢提议更安全的水嘴。
他们和街道的密切关系很甜，比短暂蜜月还长。
团队没因吵闹离婚，大家守着同一个目标。
梅独自管图表，其他人管好各自的罐子。
每人记笔记，连北街疲惫的通勤叔叔也写。
整街鼓掌，连茶铺严厉的老板也拍手。
和善的主管夸干活，从不骂慢的下属帮手。
兰选涛做搭档，不好意思为校演配鸽子。
生病的同事问好，勇敢的伙伴中午送汤。
老相识暖暖地笑，对忙碌的全组满是喜爱。
好心的陌生人看了很久，加入做热切的学徒帮手。
疲惫的副手向街上每个小英雄鞠躬。
雨轻轻落在安静的屋顶，洗净了尘土小巷。
戏剧社的勇敢女主角和害羞的女演员大声喝彩。
严厉的大臣没来，退休的指挥官寄来暖心字条。
集市的和善主任一直支持学生作品。
集市委员会开了两次会，镇议会借出桌椅。
他们选兰做代表，有南街的水专家指导。
孩子们大笑，分着暖包子站在亮灯下。
植物顾问和和善的兽医夸排水安全。
学校辅导员微笑，公正的事务律师讲清规则。
没有严厉的律师争辩，平静的裁判公平计时。
商店忙碌的出纳和个子高的消防员在水嘴旁维持秩序。
温柔的护士包好作痛的指关节，开朗的园丁种下新种子。

老渔夫咧嘴笑，和善的屠夫分热包子。
男孩们轻柔地给马梳毛，不再大喊吓人。
多年辛苦劳作有了甜果，连穷乞丐也喝到清水。

paraZh: 周日爷爷讲述战争的起因与炮火，孩子们初闻战争之痛。
火星与旧武器陈列无声，爷爷把战争遗物收进木箱。
灯火旁的任务与刀剑琴弓，见证日子由武转文。
头盔盾牌下纪念馆接待客人，昔日打斗永不再来。
阴谋带来赤贫饥荒，夺粮追赶让人不忍回首。
好斗喊声无法侵犯小屋，善良规则守护旧和平。
枪声止息后智言劝止青年，农夫悄悄反抗损失。
拒绝叛徒之后，证据消散恐惧，和平愿望强烈。
走出恐惧的动荡聚会，教会人们为骄怒设限。
老敌变挚友，巧谋蓝图与劝告化为助人力量。

远离野蛮与邪念，牺牲睡眠换来对死伤者的反思。
墓园寂静海陆安眠，石阶之上和平在心中生长。
军车不扰果园，风险灾难只留在 教训里。
止息争吵干扰，退守妥协让出和平之路。
抛弃口号与杂草，温柔书信迎来安静凯旋。
纪念碑石碑旁荣誉长存，巡守化为友好守望。
牡丹丛中再无障碍，老兵与孩子共享面包守望和平。
小镇理工学院请机修工带学生为清水街道创新，立志参赛。
老海员定下水域方向，基金支持下学生在院子里开工。
