网络刻度盘加电脑喇叭，录音录像记录池塘试验。
湿叶压缩、蒸汽冷凝，物理变化在冷盖上完成。
缝隙修整管子简化、灰水净化汤渣过滤、饮用水未蒸馏需更多热量，工程化思维解决生活用水难题。
调水调阀找滴水，读数变准，节水见效。
小错小绊被修好，老海员带头传承分工。
三代家庭齐上阵，祖父辈搬罐，孩子们学发豆芽。
少年青年和乡亲亲戚围观帮忙，气氛亲热。
女主人女房东烧茶管饭，首次试验全家开心。
房东借棚待客，修修补补不误约见评委。
拄拐小波也提议，全街鼓掌目标一致。
主管搭档同事相识陌生人齐夸，小英雄受敬。
戏剧喝彩加官方支持，选出代表继续冲刺。
顾问律师裁判后勤到场，比赛有序又暖心。
理发师渔夫屠夫庆功，辛苦换来清水和勇气。

title: 身体与时间
zh: 备考的一天与奶奶的健康年，两卷读完。
paragraphs: In the early morning Leo does a kind [[deed:deed]] to [[accustom:accustom]] himself to waking early.
He hears the alarm and learns to [[react:react]] fast and [[reflect:reflect]] calmly on yesterday.
Leo must [[bear:bear]] the cold air and [[adopt:adopt]] a strong plan for the long day.
A warm breakfast can [[nourish:nourish]] his body while father helps [[mow:mow]] the small front grass.
Leo steps outside to [[exhale:exhale]] white air and check his daily food [[intake:intake]] plan.
A cup of hot milk can [[revive:revive]] his tired head so he can [[survive:survive]] busy mornings.
The low sun sends a sharp [[glare:glare]] but Leo gets a quick [[glimpse:glimpse]] of the bus.
Leo takes a fast [[glance:glance]] at his watch and takes a [[peep:peep]] down the long road.
His steady [[gaze:gaze]] stays on the road while he tries to [[peer:peer]] through light morning rain.
He [[contemplate:contemplate]]d the stars and [[stare:stare]]d at the night sky.
An [[oath:oath]] was taken and a solemn [[vow:vow]] made silently.
A [[pledge:pledge]] was given and the [[whistler:whistler]] sang softly.
Leo will [[reply:reply]] to his mother and [[notify:notify]] his friend about the late bus.
He likes to [[assert:assert]] his idea clearly and then [[explain:explain]] the bus delay calmly.
Two boys start a loud [[quarrel:quarrel]] but the driver stops the small [[dispute:dispute]] quickly.
After the short [[argument:argument]] Leo must [[hasten:hasten]] on foot to reach the school gate.
A kind guard seems to [[urge:urge]] him to run and does not [[scold:scold]] him for lateness.
Leo will not [[curse:curse]] the bad luck and will not [[swear:swear]] at the heavy traffic.
A rude shout could [[provoke:provoke]] ire but the teacher only wants to [[preach:preach]] patience.
Leo does not [[boast:boast]] about his scores and does not [[tease:tease]] his tired classmates.
Nobody will [[mock:mock]] his accent and many friends will [[clap:clap]] for his short speech.
Classmates loudly [[applaud:applaud]] his effort as Leo tries to [[catch:catch]] each useful word.
He does not [[snatch:snatch]] other books and does not [[grab:grab]] pens from shared desks.
Leo wants to [[overtake:overtake]] his old self and keep a firm [[grip:grip]] on daily habits.
The [[mess:mess]] was cleaned and the [[twist:twist]] in the rope undone.
Each [[fold:fold]] was smoothed and nothing left to [[scatter:scatter]].
Every [[fasten:fasten]]ing was checked and nothing left to [[loosen:loosen]].
The desk will not be [[smash:smash]]ed in ire nor the wall [[scratch:scratch]]ed with his pen.
Mud is helped [[scrape:scrape]]d from shoes and the old classroom windows helped [[polish:polish]]ed.
The cleaning tasks will be [[split:split]] evenly while trees [[sway:sway]] gently outside the window.
His phone starts to [[vibrate:vibrate]] softly while dust seems to [[whirl:whirl]] in the warm light.
The fan blades [[rotate:rotate]] slowly above as Leo feels thoughts [[reel:reel]] inside his tired head.
Students [[shuffle:shuffle]] their feet at lunch time but do not [[collide:collide]] in the narrow hall.
Leo likes to [[combine:combine]] rice with vegetables and [[integrate:integrate]] fruit into his lunch.
Good food smells seem to [[penetrate:penetrate]] the hall and [[pierce:pierce]] his sleepy afternoon mood.
He will [[insert:insert]] his meal card quickly and [[tilt:tilt]] his tray to keep it steady.
After lunch friends [[tow:tow]] the ball bag together and follow the dusty [[trail:trail]] to courts.
They help to [[arrange:arrange]] cones in lines and learn to [[manipulate:manipulate]] the ball well.
The coach teaches Leo to [[steer:steer]] his runs and lets sweat [[baptise:baptise]] his shirt in heat.
Nobody wants to [[bet:bet]] money on the game or put pride at [[stake:stake]] after school.
They will not [[gamble:gamble]] with safety and only share a fair [[promise:promise]] to play clean.
Fast games always [[attract:attract]] many students but Leo does not [[obsess:obsess]] over final scores.
Smooth moves can [[mesmerize:mesmerize]] young fans but missing shots feels like a short [[nightmare:nightmare]].
Leo can [[amaze:amaze]] his team with passes and they [[marvel:marvel]] at his quick footwork.
His jump can [[astonish:astonish]] tall rivals and [[involve:involve]] every friend in loud cheers.
A bad call may [[annoy:annoy]] tired players but must not [[upset:upset]] their friendly mood.
Strange rules can [[bewilder:bewilder]] new players and that is the small [[irony:irony]] of street games.
Leo hates the [[indignity:indignity]] of cheating and shows [[contempt:contempt]] for rude foul play.
He will not show [[neglect:neglect]] for training rules or [[disregard:disregard]] for the coach voice.
Playing through [[ignorance:ignorance]] of rules shows [[bias:bias]] and often brings needless fouls.
Leo will not [[deviate:deviate]] from fair play or face orders to [[expel:expel]] him.
He will not [[flee:flee]] from strong rivals or [[bully:bully]] smaller kids on the court.
Last seconds can bring [[panic:panic]] but loud shouts should not [[terrify:terrify]] young players.
Thoughts of [[revenge:revenge]] for last loss cannot [[kidnap:kidnap]] his calm and friendly mood.
Nobody can [[hijack:hijack]] the happy game or [[smuggle:smuggle]] bad feelings into the team.
Fair judges will [[convict:convict]] cheaters in stories while stress tries to [[strangle:strangle]] pleasure.
It was no bloody [[massacre:massacre]] of scores, only a fair [[decimation:decimation]] of old fears.
The coach may [[intervene:intervene]] to stop fights that [[impede:impede]] happy team spirit.
Victory has strong [[allure:allure]] but sweet words are only [[bait:bait]] for heedless young minds.
Kind cheers can [[induce:induce]] fresh energy and never [[tempt:tempt]] players toward rude tricks.
After games teachers will [[designate:designate]] reading zones and [[assign:assign]] pages for night study.
Helpers will [[distribute:distribute]] clean worksheets and quickly [[despatch:despatch]] messages to late teammates.
To [[detach:detach]] is to [[undo:undo]] the knot carefully.
He would not [[conceal:conceal]] the truth nor [[disguise:disguise]] his feelings.
No one should [[exclude:exclude]] others or [[refuse:refuse]] help when needed.
He would [[assure:assure]] her and never [[reverse:reverse]] his decision.
Leo will [[undertake:undertake]] extra listening drills that clearly [[stipulate:stipulate]] daily time limits.
Good scores can [[convince:convince]] his father and [[reassure:reassure]] his worried family at home.
Leo learns to [[aspire:aspire]] high and control wild [[desire:desire]] for games and phones.
He seems to [[yearn:yearn]] for broad knowledge and often [[invoke:invoke]] great past examples.
An inner [[itch:itch]] for progress drives each new [[attempt:attempt]] at difficult listening tasks.
Leo will [[strive:strive]] each evening and slowly [[fulfil:fulfil]] his weekly study plan.
A [[loom:loom]] stood ready and the threads began to [[sort:sort]] themselves.
To [[commence:commence]] is to [[launch:launch]] the day with purpose.
He would not [[exploit:exploit]] others but [[explore:explore]] new paths.
To [[exert:exert]] effort is to [[tackle:tackle]] each challenge directly.
He learned to [[cope:cope]] with stress and [[dispose:dispose]] of worry.
His [[conduct:conduct]] was honest and nothing was left to [[omit:omit]].
He will [[erase:erase]] wrong answers quickly and [[rescue:rescue]] useful ideas from past mistakes.
Leo will not [[resort:resort]] to long naps but will [[recover:recover]] strength with short walks.
Warm tea can [[restore:restore]] calm focus and help [[rectify:rectify]] small grammar slips.
Extra practice can [[redeem:redeem]] past lazy days and [[offset:offset]] weak spelling skills.
Fresh fruit can [[replenish:replenish]] his energy and help him [[obtain:obtain]] steady evening focus.
The library can [[supply:supply]] quiet desks that [[offer:offer]] warm light for long reading.
Tutors can [[render:render]] hard lessons simple and [[enlarge:enlarge]] small steps into big gains.
Pictures can [[augment:augment]] dull texts and [[magnify:magnify]] tiny details for tired eyes.
Microphones can [[amplify:amplify]] soft voices but teachers never [[exaggerate:exaggerate]] small student errors.
Leo will not [[prolong:prolong]] short breaks too long but will [[uphold:uphold]] firm sleep times.
Saved notes act as strong [[backup:backup]] and can [[propel:propel]] Leo toward higher bands.
Leo will [[update:update]] his word lists nightly and slowly [[raise:raise]] his practice test scores.
Rain may [[leak:leak]] through old windows and [[spill:spill]] cold water on wooden desks.
Damp air can [[seep:seep]] through cracks and make old paint [[ooze:ooze]] with wet smell.
Students need not [[evacuate:evacuate]] the hall but avoid the muddy [[trench:trench]] near gates.
Heavy rain can [[saturate:saturate]] shoes quickly, a fair [[excuse:excuse]] for being slightly late.
Teachers will [[forgive:forgive]] late steps and help young minds [[contain:contain]] worry and fright.
Leo shows deep [[regard:regard]] for cleaners and never uses lies to [[flatter:flatter]] teachers.
He does not blindly [[worship:worship]] high scores or fight for a narrow [[cause:cause]].
For the [[sake:sake]] of family love Leo keeps a clear study [[purpose:purpose]].
Each small [[objective:objective]] can slowly [[arouse:arouse]] fresh hope in his tired heart.
A low score may [[trigger:trigger]] worry but Leo will still [[seek:seek]] wise help.
He can [[retrieve:retrieve]] old notes fast and let results [[testify:testify]] to hard work.
Leo will [[verify:verify]] answers twice and clearly [[specify:specify]] time for each task.
Good books can [[enlighten:enlighten]] young minds and warmly [[impart:impart]] timeless study skills.
Hard workers truly [[deserve:deserve]] good bands and never let focus [[drop:drop]] at night.
Leo will not let hope [[sink:sink]] low or let scores [[plummet:plummet]] from lazy nights.
He learns to [[muffle:muffle]] phone noise so stress cannot [[overshadow:overshadow]] calm thought.
At dawn he will [[greet:greet]] his mother and proudly [[salute:salute]] the morning flag.
Teachers will [[congratulate:congratulate]] his progress and kind elders will [[bless:bless]] his brave path.
Leo wants to [[participate:participate]] in contests before waving a warm [[farewell:farewell]] to fears.
He will [[assort:assort]] notes by color so answers [[correspond:correspond]] well to questions.
Teachers act in kind [[accord:accord]] with rules and [[attribute:attribute]] gains to steady effort.
Leo can [[recall:recall]] morning words well and quietly [[recollect:recollect]] evening grammar rules.
Short cards can [[remind:remind]] him of phrases so he can [[retell:retell]] stories simply.
Leo will [[repeat:repeat]] key sentences aloud and write a calm nightly [[retrospect:retrospect]].
Steady habits can [[impress:impress]] firm judges and help Leo [[surmount:surmount]] final test fears.
Small failures need not [[mortify:mortify]] young hearts while calm hope can [[pervade:pervade]] the room.
To [[replace:replace]] the old part is to [[substitute:substitute]] it entirely.
He learned to [[differentiate:differentiate]] truth from lies and [[distinguish:distinguish]] friends from foes.
He would not [[incline:incline]] to anger nor [[lean:lean]] on excuses.
At last Leo turns [[sideways:sideways]] to smile at the moon and then sleeps with hope.
Grandma lost her [[temper:temper]] quickly, but she spoke in a soft [[manner:manner]] at home.
Her calm [[attitude:attitude]] shows her warm and kind [[personality:personality]] to us all.
Patience is her best [[trait:trait]], and kindness is her greatest [[virtue:virtue]] in life.
Her smile is a special [[feature:feature]], though old age has bent her [[stature:stature]] a bit.
She says soft [[flesh:flesh]] is part of life for all [[mankind:mankind]] on earth.
The doctor said her leg [[bone:bone]] is soft, for Grandpa is the [[backbone:backbone]] of our house.
The wall chart showed the full [[skeleton:skeleton]] and the round [[skull:skull]] very clearly.
A strong [[brain:brain]] needs good sleep, and a calm [[mind:mind]] needs love each day.
Grandma needs both [[physical:physical]] care and warm [[mental:mental]] support from the family.
The nurse touched her red [[cheek:cheek]] and warm [[forehead:forehead]] with gentle hands.
Sweat stood on her [[brow:brow]], and tears hung on her long [[eyelash:eyelash]] that morning.
Her dry [[lip:lip]] was bitten and more [[space:space]] asked for to breathe in the room.
Her [[tongue:tongue]] was put out and the doctor looked deep into her red [[throat:throat]] quickly.
Living near a green [[gorge:gorge]], her small [[chin:chin]] was lifted to answer loudly.
Her stiff [[jaw:jaw]] ached a little, so she slowly moved her long [[neck:neck]] left and right.
Grandpa stroked his grey [[beard:beard]] and put his hand on her shaking [[shoulder:shoulder]] softly.
Her slow [[limb:limb]] felt heavy, and she rested her aching [[elbow:elbow]] on the table edge.
The nurse held her thin [[wrist:wrist]] and pressed her small [[thumb:thumb]] to test strength.
Grandma opened her warm [[palm:palm]] and pointed with one shaking [[finger:finger]] at the chart.
The first check was to listen to her wide [[chest:chest]] with a black tube.
Then the doctor pressed her soft [[abdomen:abdomen]] and counted each lower [[rib:rib]] one by one.
He tied a band round her thin [[waist:waist]] to scan each inner [[organ:organ]] with echo waves.
He said her kind [[liver:liver]] looked fine, but her empty [[stomach:stomach]] needed warm food daily.
Years ago her [[womb:womb]] held my mother, and now one [[kidney:kidney]] works a bit slowly.
Her left [[lung:lung]] sounded low, and one small [[gland:gland]] felt bigger than before.
